articleTitle: Compressed sensing MRI based on nonsubsampled contourlet transform
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: How to reduce acquisition time is very important in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). Compressed sensing MRI emerges recently to suppress the aliasing when undersampling k-space data is employed. However, typical sparse transform for compressed sensing MRI ever used is wavelet, which only captures limited directional information with decay rate M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>. In this paper, we introduce contourlet into compressed sensing to obtain a sparse expansion for smooth contours with decay rate C(logM)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>M<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and employ nonsubsampled contourlet to increase the redundancy of basis for magnetic resonance images. We propose compressed sensing MRI based on nonsubsampled contourlet transform (NSCT). Experimental results demonstrate that NSCT outperforms wavelet on suppressing the aliasing and improves the visual appearance of magnetic resonance images.

articleTitle: Preprocessing study of retinal image based on component extraction
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Extracting the clear retinal image information is a prerequisite for diagnosing the patientpsilas conditions exactly in clinic. In order to extract the clear retinal image with less data as assistant diagnosis, the histogram equalization preprocessing of colored retinal image is researched based on its features. The clarity is observed and analyzed by comparing equalization images of the colored retinal imagepsilas gray image, red component image, green component image and blue component image. Equalization images of the green component image is the most clear one, followed by equalization images of the colored retinal image, red component image and blue component image. The green component image not only holds the basic feature of the original color image with its data compressed down to 1/3, but also is more convenient to acquire.

articleTitle: Medical Knowledge Acquisition Through Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Data mining has been widely considered as an effective tool for knowledge discovery. This paper discusses the important role of medical experts for medical data mining, and presents a model of medical knowledge acquisition through data mining.

articleTitle: A fast algorithm for three-Dimensional Otsu’s Thresholding method
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: While performing well in segmenting on images with low SNR and low contrast, the three-Dimensional Otsupsilas threshold algorithm has the disadvantage of high computational complexity. By removing the redundant computation and computing look-up table with iteration, this paper improves the complexity greatly and gives a fast algorithm for the three-Dimensional Otsupsilas threshold algorithm. experimental results show that the algorithm reduces calculation time substantially with no quality loss in the threshold compared with the original algorithm.

articleTitle: SOAP based Assistive Care Loop using wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: There is a growing trend towards in-house health monitoring system. It is now feasible to place a Personal Digital Assistant (PDA) or smart phone in the hands of care-delivery staff and the patients regardless of where they are located or what their duties might be. In such instance, the staff would be able to access records and communicate with patients in a flexible and cost effective way. This paper proposes an Active Care Loop Framework (ACLF). The strength of our ACLF is to monitor disease over longer period of time and to consult patient who are then able to discuss their conditions with the care staff. Where patients need emergency intervention, an assistive health monitoring system can provide a direct communication channel to summon assistance and to enable with managing the situation until the assistance arrives. With a regular schedule of monitoring and consultation, the assistive ACLF has the capacity to forestall and manage non-critical situations and therefore the system can be deployed to minimize the rate and costs of hospitalizations.

articleTitle: Students’ needs of e-courses as complement to traditional learning: A Japanese studies e-course case
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With rapid technological development and strong needs from the students, many institutes have introduced e-learning components to complement traditional face-to-face teaching. This paper investigates the usefulness of different sessions of an alpha Japanese e-learning system based on the survey conducted by the ITS Unit of the HKU SPACE. The learners were asked to test the system and gave feedback in the questionnaire. By examining their likeness to the system and the relative popular sections, features which feed the learnerspsila needs are known. It gives us some insights and direction for future e-learning development. The results of the survey are generally positive and most of the respondents rated the Japanese e-learning system high. It is concluded from the results that learners generally found the Japanese e-learning system helpful to their studies and more specifically, functions like sound emission, flash and videos were relatively helpful in the eyes of learners.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of intrusion detection based on mobile agents
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we introduced the intrusion detection technology first. Beside of the definition and the common intrusion detection frame (CDIF), we described three methods of the intrusion detection: anomaly detection, misuse detection and hybrid detection. Then we discussed the mobile agent technology. In this part, we mainly introduced three key issues. They are: mobile agentpsilas move, mobile agentpsilas cooperation and mobile agentpsilas security. Because the mobile, autonomous agents have the potential to provide a convenient, efficient and robust programming paradigm for distributed applications, we applied them into the intrusion detection systems, and proposed a new intrusion detection model. This model used the mobile agent as organization unit, combined the distributed idea, fully used the intelligence, mobility, cooperation and heterogeneity of the mobile agents and designed a concurrent structure of the mobile agents. It can detect the intrusions accurately and quickly, thereby overcoming the flaw of the traditional intrusion detection system.

articleTitle: A context-aware prototype system for adaptive learning content in ubiquitous environment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Ubiquitous computing devices are transforming the way that learners study. But most of e-learning contents designed for PC are not suitable for handheld devices. In addition, some materials, irrelevant to learnerpsilas preferences or contextual environments, may affect the learning efficiency, and also increase the communication costs. In order to provide adaptive contents according to device capabilities and learnerpsilas experience, this paper presents a functional framework for adaptation contents. Last, the context-aware prototype system is experimentally evaluated on standard document learning materials: PowerPoint files. Through the framework, the learning contents are adaptive to learnerpsilas preference, also adaptive to contextual environment.

articleTitle: Hand motion pattern classifier based on EMG using wavelet packet transform and LVQ neural networks
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, a novel electromyographic (EMG) motion pattern classifier using wavelet packet transform (WPT) and Learning Vector Quantization (LVQ) Neural Networks is proposed. This motion pattern classifier can successfully identify wrist extension, wrist flexion, hand extension and hand grasp, by measuring the surface EMG signals through two electrodes mounted on forearm extensor carpi ulnaris and flexor carpi ulnaris. The experimental results show that the proposed method achieves a 98% recognition accuracy. Furthermore, via quantitative comparison with other neural networks classifiers, LVQ method has a better performance. Consequently, the classifier is applicable to myoelectric hand control of 2 degrees of freedom (DOF) because of its high recognition capability.

articleTitle: Design of a video system to detect and sort the faults of cigarette package
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A hardware flatform detecting and sorting the faults of cigarette package is designed by using the technology of machine vision. Algorithm and systemic software are also designed according to its characteristics. With stability and accuracy it is of some guiding value to the high speed on-line package detection.

articleTitle: Efficient focused crawling strategy using combination of link structure and content similarity
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: At present, focused crawler usually crawl pages using the link structure or page contents. But both of them have some flaws. So we designed an efficient crawling strategy, which combine the link structure with content similarity. We extracted topic feature vector automatically and judge the topic similarity of a page using combination of link structure and page content. We also forecast the URL similarity using link structure in topic pages. Experiments showed that this strategy effectively increase the precision of fetching topic pages.

articleTitle: The research and application of online examination and monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The development of modern education technology has promoted the changes of teaching pattern and examination pattern, the appearing of online examination system (OES) is the best embodiment of these reforms, and the monitoring system is designed to ensure the fairness and impartiality of the OES. The paper provides the structure and function of OES and monitoring system, discusses the key problems about communication and security and gives the solutions. The system is satisfied with the requirement of network examination well.

articleTitle: Analyzing User Behavior History for constructing user profile
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: User behavior history has been employed to discover userpsilas preferences and interests for personalized systems. In this paper we propose a framework for extracting user interested items by analyzing user behavior history in digital library environment. Firstly, this paper models every userpsilas behaviors as a user behavior forest (UBF). Then user behavior log is formatted with several additional attributes, and we show how to construct UBF from such logs. At last, an algorithm is presented for measuring user interests on items by considering userpsilas behavior sequence, userpsilas behavior type, and the metadata of literature.

articleTitle: CT-MR image registration in liver treatment by maximization of mutual information
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: CT and MR images have been used in the liver disease treatment. In order to merge the different information into one image, image registration and data fusion must be adopted. In this paper, image registration and data fusion for MR and CT images of liver was studied. Firstly, the maximization of mutual information method was proposed to register the images. Then, some optimization algorithms, such as Powell, Brent, Golden Section and the second-degree interpolation algorithms, were applied. Finally, the post-registration images were fused with a wavelets-based scheme and the different information was merged into a new image. The experiment results demonstrated the effectiveness of the fusion scheme.

articleTitle: The application of oil and gas wells intelligent wireless monitoring system in oil field system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, oil and gas wells intelligent wireless monitoring system can real-time on-line and remotely monitor the information of flux, pressure and temperature in the oil pipelines fluid, can achieve the efficient management of data and sharing of resources, and can realize the enterprise management’s automation and information. The users have shown that the system is running in good condition. Finally, we discuss the inadequacy and needful improvement of the system.

articleTitle: Decision tree method to extract syndrome differentiation rules of posthepatitic cirrhosis in traditional Chinese medicine
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Syndrome differentiation is an important topic in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM).Decision tree, one of the data mining algorithms developed, is a method to induce rules from data. In this paper, decision tree is applied to extract syndrome differentiation rules from 293 cases related to liver and kidney yin deficiency, damp-heat smoldering and Stasis and heat smoldering syndrome. Thus the decision tree classification model is obtained and some important factors are selected to three mainly syndromes of posthepatitic cirrhosis; corresponding syndrome differentiation rules are induced from the model. The classification accuracies are 79.86%, 80.5% and 82% respectively. The experiment results show that the decision method is likely a promising method to extract diagnostic rules from patient records of Chinese medicine and could be expected to be useful in the practice of traditional Chinese medicine.

articleTitle: Automatic hotspots recognition and trends prediction in traditional medicine
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Exemplified by the field of traditional medicine in this paper, we classify articles extracted from SCIE (2004-2008) medical databases into categories from different perspectives and apply co-word analysis, multidimensional scaling methods to each category. Eventually, two maps are produced for each category, which are the current hotspots map and the trends map. Taking ldquoDrugs, Chinese, Herbalrdquo as an example, its current hotspots map reveals three hot topics: plant extraction, antioxide and cancer cell in 2008. We also find topics concerning cancer in its 2006 trends map, which proved our method regarding high growth rate words as an indicator of the future trends is valid.

articleTitle: A new image segmentation method based on HSI color space for biped soccer robot
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Many researchers now are engaging themselves in the research on vision system for humanoid soccer robot. By making a deep analysis on the HSI color space, a better algorithm is presented which is judging the main feature of current pixel dynamically according to an intensity (I value) related formula in this paper. Fuzzy K-means Clustering method is adopted in the image segmentation after all the similar pixels are found. This research is a good foundation for the future work of more complex vision based motion planning of humanoid soccer robot.

articleTitle: Analysis and classification of wrist pulse using sample entropy
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The cardiovascular system is complex system containing many nonlinearities. Pulse signals are nonlinear reflecting the status of the heart and the vascular system. Sample entropy analysis can quantify signal regularity or the system complexity generating the signal. In this paper the wrist pulse signals of healthy group and coronary heart disease group are analyzed and studied with sample entropy analysis, and the selection of parameters is discussed. The pulse signals of two groups are classified using support vector machine (SVM), the classification results are analyzed. The results indicate there was difference between the sample entropy of two groups of wrist pulse signals; SVM classifiers have good performance for classification of the two groups. Sample entropy analysis of wrist pulse was helpful for non-destructive inspection of coronary heart disease.

articleTitle: Traditional Chinese medical diagnosis based on fuzzy and certainty reasoning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Diagnosis in traditional chinese medicine (TCM) is the foundation of every TCM clinical branch. It is related to basic TCM theories, and guides TCM treatments. In this paper methodologies developed for quick and reliable TCM diagnosis are described. The diagnosis process is divided into two stages. In the first stage the scope of possible diseases and syndromes of a patient will be quickly narrowed down by a modifiable multilevel fuzzy sieving method. This sieving method follows TCM differentiation principles. In the second stage diseases and syndromes will be reliably determined by a multi-agent diagnosis helping system (MADHS) that simulates cooperated experts and makes joint decisions. Fuzziness and uncertainty are incorporated into decision trees to form the reasoning mechanism of agents. A prototype of MADHS has been implemented and successfully tested. It is anticipated that the system and methodologies may be widely used in computer aided diagnosis and TCM education software.

articleTitle: Task-driven and objective-oriented hierarchical education method: A case study in Linux curriculum
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Education in computer science disciplines, such as Linux, always focuses on both theoretical and implementation level of technology. However, the performance of traditional teaching approach is not satisfied in practice. This paper firstly gives two important issues in teaching which are ldquotask-drivenrdquo and rdquoobjective-orientedrdquo, then discusses how to integrate them into a new education method, and finally describes the application of this method in Linux curriculum as a case study.

articleTitle: An efficient authentication scheme based on the self-updating hash chain for campus network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A novel authentication scheme with self-updating hash chain is proposed for campus network, which realizes efficient identities authentication using the cryptographic features of hash chain. The self-updating hash chain solves the length limitation of traditional hash chain. Analysis are given to illustrate the proposed protocol is secure and efficient. Practical implementation show the given scheme is available and feasible. At last, the achievement of authentication server is stated.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional virtual chemical laboratory based on virtual reality modeling language
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the continuing growth of the Internet, more and more people are taking advantage of distance learning courses. However, most of long-distance education systems can not be effectively implemented chemical experimental teaching. Learners can not make a practice in network environment, which is not conducive to the consolidation of learning and practice skills training. In addition, some existing chemical experimental systems have mostly used multimedia courseware or flash that is a two-dimensional and lack of interactive. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a three-dimensional interactive virtual chemical laboratory framework based on VRML. The framework is based on constructivist learning theory, three-dimensional modeling and scene interactive technology of VRML. Through using three-dimensional modeling, the system can show a real experimental environment. At the same time, utilizing scene interactive technology, it can implement the complex human-machine interaction in chemistry, so that the learners get the senses of realism and immersion.

articleTitle: An improved AntTree algorithm for MRI brain segmentation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, an improved method is proposed based on the AntTree algorithm to deal with MRI brain segmentation. This algorithm uses a new tree-structure model to accelerate the calculation of segmenting the brain structure into brain structure, while matter, grey matter, and cerebrospinal fluid. The experimental results indicated that this new approach has made full usage of the pixels information of MRI. Compared with K-means algorithm and FCM algorithm, the results show that the improved AntTree algorithm is characterized by faster, robustness and accurateness.

articleTitle: An innovative remote experiment system for FPGA-based curriculum
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: An innovative remote experiment system is brought forward and realized in the paper, which is developed to allow using of FPGA devices remotely via World Wide Web. Using this system, students would have the opportunities to design digital circuits and implement them into FPGA, even if the FPGA devices are not available in their location. The system is aimed at structuring a new open mode of computer hardware design experiment, supplementing remote theory teaching effectively, and resolving the problem that experiment teaching could not keep up with theory teaching in the distance education. There are two innovative approaches in the system design. The first, the network of the system is built based on embedded Web services technology, which is in the lead in technology field. The second is using boundary-scan technology as electric probe to realize remote experiment verification. There are no precedents applying boundary-scan testing technology to the experiment system in education field, so the idea is original.

articleTitle: Application of sequential patterns based on user’s interest in intrusion detection
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: There are a mass of pattern rules in network audit record database, however users may be interested in only a part of them, if the pattern rules are mined only by setting the support threshold without any constraint, it will cause lots of redundant pattern rules which are not interested by users, and it is also hard to understand. In this paper, we mainly discuss such a method how to refine the pattern rules and reduce redundant rules as soon as possible according to userspsila interest in intrusion detection. Thereby, the axis attributes and constraint condition are introduced to improve the sequential pattern mining algorithm PrefixSpan, which could be applied in data mining module of NIDS. The analysis of results shows that the optimized algorithm is able to mine the set of frequent episode rules which users interest effectively in network audit database.

articleTitle: F-score feature selection method may improve texture-based liver segmentation strategies
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A fast computer-aided liver segmentation plays a vital role in computer aided surgery (CAS), especially when using texture-based methods. Large amount of features yielded in supervised segmentation methods may result in slow segment processes. In order to reduce the time required in the segment stage, we applied principal component analysis (PCA), forward orthogonal search by maximizing the overall dependency (FOSMOD), and F-score to our supervised method proposed recently. Our results showed that the F-score may help in accelerating segment stage by approximately 42% whilst the PCA-based feature selection method failed to extract the liver contour correctly. Though FOSMOD can obtain a good segmentation result of liver, it is time consuming comparing with the other two methods. Thus, F-score method may provide an effective solution for accelerating liver segmentation.

articleTitle: A sub-health self-check system using image information of eye expression
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the modern society, people live in a state of tension and have great pressure; their bodies are often sub-healthy. The western medicine is expensive and hard to self-check sub-health at home. The Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) can diagnose sub-health and can prompt patients their coming disease. This paper describes an experimental sub-health self-check system, which is simple and low-cost. This paper introduces emphatically how the system uses image information of eye expression as its input.

articleTitle: A teaching evaluation model based on information entropy and its application
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Most universities and colleges are employing teaching evaluations to guide their work. However, no feasible and effective systems satisfy their requirements currently. This paper first presents a suit of evaluation indices based on the multiple evaluation subjects and developmental evaluation theory. Then, a teaching evaluation model based on information entropy is proposed, in which weight calculation of evaluation indices doesnpsilat require past experiences and is easily implemented by computers. At last, the information entropy based teaching evaluation system (IETES) is described, which adopts B/S architecture and is deployed on the Internet. The applications in our school show that the IETES is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Thinking of promoting basic computer education to information technology literacy education in college
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to keep up with the computer science development and national informationization, basic computer education has been deeply reformed in domestic college. After investigating the present situation of basic computer education and its reformation, a new reformatting scheme is proposed. Basic computer education in college should be promoted to information technology literacy education, which students’ information technology literacy and practice ability will be strengthened. In this scheme, the teaching process is divided into three stages: basic information technology literacy education, application ability of information technology literacy education, information technology literacy of specialty education. And modularized courses are prepared for students in each stage. The detail of corresponding lecture and experiment curricula system is also researched.

articleTitle: 16-bit teaching microprocessor design and application
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The existing commercial microprocessors are provided as black box units, with which users are unable to monitor internal signals and operation process, neither can they modify the original structure. So they are unsuitable for teaching. In order to solve this problem, the present paper designs a simplified but fully functional 16-bit teaching microprocessor using the microprogrammed control method. The microprocessor is easy-to-modify as a VHDL and Verilog HDL modular, hierarchical description, gives access to every internal signal, and is open for user modifications. The design of ALU was optimized so that it consumes fewer resources. The microprocessor was implemented on Xilinx FPGA and has been applied in the Computer Organization and Architecture course for four years.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of case in CG case teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper discusses some questions and the limitation in traditional teaching of computer graphics(CG), and a new teaching model-case teaching is presented according to the characteristic of CG, namely all theories or algorithms of CG are included in a synthetic computer scenes case. Then a concrete case is designed and implemented by Visual C++. Implementation steps for case teaching is introduced in detail, and then the multimedia teaching based on the new teaching model is researched. It has been proved that the efficiency and quality of teaching have been improved in practice.

articleTitle: Research on low-cost virtual studio system for education resource authoring
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of virtual studio technology, the application in the field of education has been emerging in China, especially for high-quality educational resource authoring. However traditional virtual studio systems have not been widely deployed. The reason is not only the large investment but also the complexity of the operation and maintenance of the system. Thus new virtual studio system meeting the actual needs for education applications should be developed. In this paper a novel low-cost virtual studio system with convenient operating interfaces is presented. The system provides convenient and integrated functions and interfaces for high quality education resource authoring, while only one system operator is required. With the help of this system, dramatic and vivid presentation of the education resource can be generated, bringing the improvement of the efficiency and quality of education activity.

articleTitle: Research on characteristics of pulse delineation in TCM & omnidirectional pulse detecting by electro-pulsograph
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Pulse diagnosis is one of the most distinct theories in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). The study on pulse diagnosis objectification is one of the most characteristics of pulse tracings study in modern times. According to the study characteristics, the study on pulse diagnosis standardization includes three aspects: electro-pulsograph development, clinical research and data statistical analysis. And the electro-pulsograph development is more important than two other aspects, because it is the basis of the study on pulse diagnosis standardization. The research in this thesis involves the study on the theory and the design of the new-style omnidirectional electro-pulsograph. The aims of this research are: (1) To analyze the feature of pulse tracings delineation in TCM and establish the theoretical basis of electro-pulsograph detection. (2)To establish the effective method that can realize the repeatability of electro-pulsograph detection. (3) To explore the effective method that can resist the external interfere. (4) To reproduce the pulse throb locus objectively by combining the clinical and scientific research requirements of TCM.

articleTitle: Research on distributed GIS process modeling and integration
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The rapid progress of GIS application has put forward higher demands to GIS software. Although the secondary development capabilities and degree of openness of GIS software have improved greatly now, but there are still many problems, such as the inadequacy of spatial data handling and analysis capacity, poor openness, difficult sharing of data and services. The paper provides a solution of rapid application development for distributed GIS software project in view of engineering technology. Based on the relating theories of process modeling and management technology of workflow, the goal of the paper is the development of GIS application software that is space-oriented transaction processing and decision support. Concept model of spatial data suitable for process modeling will be discussed. Based on the process model of workflow, the paper combines system implementation method of process modeling which includes the distributional GIS technology and the software component technology.

articleTitle: An adaptive personalized e-learning model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Adaptive e-learning system, deal with appropriate personalization and adaptation techniques in order to maximize the effectiveness of learning. Customer preference and personality are going to be more and more important to e-learning. This paper first hopes to explain the grid agent e-learning model, whose main actions including registry, directory and discovery. Through these actions, the managerpsilas agent will find out the suitable learning services. Secondly, to implement the adaptability of the grid agent model, the method of artificial psychology and how to realize adaptive personalized e-learning by this method so that the studentpsilas agent can employ the learning material matched to their own personality type are also emphasized. The experiment data also supported our assumption that the learners may perform better if they use our adaptive grid agent model.

articleTitle: Privacy-preserving DBSCAN on horizontally partitioned data
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Privacy preserving data mining of distributed data is an important direction for data mining, and privacy preserving clustering is one of the main researches. At present, most privacy preserving clustering algorithms are concentrated on k-means and based on two parties and a trusted third party, clustering results are uncertain and hard to find complex shape clusters, and the protocols are inefficient because of using encryption, so we propose a algorithm called HPPDBSCAN based on semi-honest models for horizontally partitioned databases using some secure protocols such as secure sum computation, scalar product computation, standardization, and comparison by means of a semi-honest third party. The algorithm resolves the problem of privacy preserving under semi-honest circumstance for multi-party. Theoretic argument and example analysis demonstrate that the scheme is secure and complete with good efficiency.

articleTitle: Discussion of the reform and implementation in the curriculum design about single-chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper firstly explains the meaning of the reform in the curriculum design about SCM (single-chip microcomputer), and introduces the teaching status quo of SCM curriculum design. Then, the reform scheme and its implementation of the curriculum design is explicated, which emphasize the cultivation of project design ability and creative ability of students through providing several development boards self-designed by our teaching team and also offering several applicable projects with different difficulties. At last, the evaluation of the reform is summed up.

articleTitle: A collaborative filtering algorithm based on rating distribution
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Collaborative filter algorithms are one of the most successful recommender technologies in the world, and have been widely adopted in E-commerce. However, these approaches always suffer from poor prediction quality problem. We analyzed the rating distribution of dataset, and dig out that most of the users are interested on several specific topics, which show the user’s true interest. So we propose a new collaborative filtering algorithm based on rating distribution (BRDCF). Finally, we experimentally evaluate our approach and compare it with classical collaborative filtering methods; the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: The application of AdaBoost-neural network in storedproduct insect classification
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The classification of stored product insects has been an important and difficult aspect of grain reserve in the world. The existing classification methods cannot acquire excellent performance. AdaBoost, an adaptive boosting algorithm, may improve the classification accuracy of any given classifier. In this paper AdaBoost is adopted to increase the performance of artificial neural network for stored product insect classification, and compared with standard neural network methods. Experiment results show that the new method is efficient and a significant improvement in classification accuracy is obtained.

articleTitle: A new approach based on a rough set and a decision tree to bank customer credit evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper proposes a new approach to customer credit evaluation by synthesizing the rough set theory and decision tree theory. It adopts and improves a algorithm by Yuan Zhen, et al, (2005) while applying the rough set theory in attribute reduction. It also applies the C4.5 Algorithm proposed by Quinlan to build a decision tree model and adjusts relevant parameters during tree pruning period. Experimental results show that the approach has a better performance in terms of efficiency as well as prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Towards the objectification of tongue diagnosis: the degree of tooth-marked
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Tongue diagnosis is one of the most valuable and widely used diagnostic methods in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). A tooth-marked tongue is an important objective index of the diagnosis of qi (yang) deficiency syndrome during the diagnosis of the TCM. In order to accurately analyze it, an effective method to confirm the amount of tooth-marked and to attain the degree of tooth-marked is brought forward. It sufficiently applies the characters of GVF Snake and the features of the curvatures and gradients in the all points of tongue contour. The experiment results demonstrate the efficiency of our proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: A video transmission algorithm over the Internet based on FEC and Kalman
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Real-time video communication is very important to the Internet applications of video conferencing, video telephony, video-on-demand, and etc. However, the heavy traffic of video data along with its timing constraints makes it a challenge to provide large-scale, high QoS media streaming service over the current best-effect network. This paper presents a self-adapted feedback algorithm for video transmission which is based on the FEC coding technology and the Kalman filter theory. By modifying the rate using the adapted Kalman filter, this algorithm efficiently solves the problem of rate fluctuation caused by the lost packets. It reduces the network load caused by the retransmission of lost packets. It also weakens the influence of the loss of elementary layer packets (or other important contents) in transmission and provides the continuity of the video transmission over Internet. Simulation results indicate that this algorithm can guarantee satisfied performance for video transmission in the high-packet- lost networks.

articleTitle: Architecture and design of education IPTV for E-learning in Rural Area
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To make sure that the distance learning teaching and learning process occurs appropriately, this paper proposes an available architecture to describe the applications of e-learning in rural area by means of Internet Protocol Television (IPTV). According to this architecture, the detail design will be presented. Both education requirement and network restriction are taken into considerations. Furthermore, convenience and interactive capability are our main objects.

articleTitle: Trained SVMs based rules extraction method for text classification
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The automatic text classification method aims to assign text files to one or more predefined categories according to the text information contained by all kinds of text format files. SVM is recognized as one of the most effective text classification methods for its high accuracy, but its black-box feature causes that the description of each category can not be given and explained. In this paper, a new rule extraction method for text classification based on trained SVMs is proposed to solve the bottleneck of SVMs. The experiments show that the proposed approach can improve the validity of the extracted rules remarkably compared to C4.5 either in speed or accuracy.

articleTitle: The research and design of the Grain monitor and control system based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper will introduce the FNN theory to the data analysis of the Grain monitoring system, which(the proposed system) integrates the information of the temperature and humidity, combines them organically to gain the internal ecological changing rule of the stacked grain, shows accurate information of the grain stack for safety, and implements intelligent analysis of the grain safety in different level based on the FNN, then apply effective information to help administrator maintain the safety level of the grain in depot.

articleTitle: A frame for modelling collective learning behaviors based on cellular automata
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we present a general frame for modelling and simulating collective learning behaviors of human groups with interactions. In our “bottom-up” method, we assume that individuals learn to make their decisions repeatedly, following their studies on the performances of their former behaviors. Behavior of each individual is driven by temporal situation of the system and individual’s anticipation with respect to future decisions of other individuals, which can be calculated from individuals’ properties, such as strategy-sets, profit functions, beliefs about history information and future situation, and so on. Some learning rules, e.g. reinforcement learning, are also discussed for updating individuals’ properties during evolution of the system. Cellular Automata is employed in the frame to compute and observe the visualized long-term behaviors of the system at higher group level. Experiments show that the modelled collective systems with certain learning schemes can reach some balanced state under restrictive conditions. Our framework is helpful for study of modelling and simulating social dynamic systems, and researching higher-level behaviors of collective system with learning techniques.

articleTitle: Instructional-Designed Strategy for Massive Multiplayer Online M-learning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: We have developed a prototype system of integrating immersive elements from massive multiplayer online game (MMOG) and systematic principles of Instructional Design Methodology (ID) into mobile learning (M-learning), in order to counter M-learningpsilas preceding problems of low motivational level towards learning and weak standards to deliver the learning environment. Experiments were conducted on the prototype system with students of Waseda University and Malaysian volunteers to produce notable results for further analysis. This paper reports on the instructional-designed strategies for the M-learning based on the test results of the dual-integration and educational standard specifications.

articleTitle: A case study on collaborative e-tutoring
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The meaning of collaborative e-tutoring is all of the e-tutors work together toward the objectives of the online course, which offers supports to other e-tutors or e- learners, and shares their experiences of e-tutoring. Based on our experiences of collaborative e-tutoring, we explore how it works in an intercultural e-learning course. 45 participants and six e-tutors (three from UK and three from China) were involved in this 11 weeks online course, and Moodle was used as VLE (virtual learning environment). Results demonstrate that collaborative e-tutoring is a very important strategy for tutoring in an intercultural context.

articleTitle: Research of Genetic Algorithm in function optimization based on HCI
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Function optimization is useful for us in the research and the development of genetic algorithm. By traditional methods, it will not solve the function optimization problem with satisfied solution. When turning to genetic algorithm, the solution can reach the optimum. This paper gives a brief overview of the research, development and application of genetic algorithm in the beginning. Moreover, a new method of research in genetic algorithm was presented in this paper. It mainly discussed the solution of function optimization problems using genetic algorithm based on a Human Computer Interaction platform, which improves the efficiency of the research.The simulation and analysis of the results got from this platform for solving function optimization problem showed us the good performance of genetic algorithm as well as the convenience and feasibility of the HCI platform.

articleTitle: The region partition of quality and coating for tongue image based on color image segmentation method
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The recognition of tongue image is one of the essential contents for automatic diagnosis of tongue information. The identification of tongue quality and coating is an important procedure in the tongue diagnosis, and it is also the premise for analyzing the color of tongue quality and coating and its texture characteristics in the later stage. This paper employs "division-merging method" and "chrominance-threshold method" to distinguish the tongue quality and coating on the basis of color image segmentation method. The results show that the two methods work well in the area partition of the quality and coating of tongue images.

articleTitle: The application of UHF RFID technology in mine locomotive positioning system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the light of the problem of poor real-timing and low reliability in the traditional method of mine locomotive location system, this paper puts forward an application which uses UHF RFID technology in the mine locomotive positioning system. Combining with the special environment in mine, this paper introduces the hardware and software design of UHF RFID so that the mine management will be fully intelligentized, digitalized, and information-based.

articleTitle: Analyzing group learning behavior based on cellular automata
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Simulating collective behaviors of human groups with interactions has essential importance in education, economics, psychology and other social science fields. In this paper, we gave a cellular automata based method to analyze group learning behavior. The paper analyzed the interaction relationship between individual behavior and group evolvement, and discussed how the evolvement of group is affected by qualified rate in initial condition, the interaction level and distribution of individuals in the sense of statistics. A large number of experiments are employed to show how some main factors effect the group evolvement and to draw related conclusions.

articleTitle: A new wireless network teaching and learning system based on network simulator
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of telecommunication engineering and mobile computing, some related curricula are provided in lots of universities and colleges in our country. However, many students complain that they have to spend a lot of time in learning materials and are frustrated with them. This paper describes WNTLS, a wireless network teaching and learning system based on the network simulator (NS-2) that facilitates students to model, tune and analyze the performance of various types of wireless networks in the telecommunication engineering curricula.

articleTitle: The basic data of pulse condition and health development monitoring system based on pulse condition
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Pulse-taking is a characteristic technique of diagnosis in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and plays a very important role in TCM clinical practice. The diversity of pulse condition can reflect the change of organs and entrails as well as QI-blood and body fluid in human body. It is one important index of health monitoring. In this paper, we expound the formation of biometric characteristic of pulse condition, some important constituents of biometric characteristic of pulse condition, extraction and identification in pulse condition and its standardization. We propose biometric characteristic in pulse condition is inherited, individual; the characteristic establishment of the primary standard of pulse condition bases plays a very important role in TCM treatment based on syndrome differentiation, health monitoring, evaluation on curative effect. Extraction in pulse condition should be developed with age, pulse training instrument with good repeatability and stability should be manufactured and developed, the establishment of health development monitoring system based on pulse condition and pulse training instrument will be benefit to disease treatment and prevention.

Author Keywords: the basic data of pulse condition

articleTitle: Affordable high-performance environment for education in undeveloped regions
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper will present a new intensive-computing environment for education. The environment is different from the conventional high-performance platforms which are very expensive and isn’t fit for normal education, especially from the poor area. It adopts Cell system to build low level cluster, and the operating system for the cluster is gentoo linux OS, and the Cell SDK is used to build the development environment, and MPI adopted by the environment is Open-MPI, which is an open source MPI-2 implementation. Cell system is a new kind of heterogeneous multi-core system. There are nine cores in one processor. The node of the cluster is built by the ps3 which adopted the cell as the processor. Gentoo linux, Cell SDK and Open-MPI are released under GPL, which can be gotten easily by users. The environment has many characters, such as low cost, high performance, easy building and maintenance, easy learning and development, and so on.

articleTitle: Developing QTI compliant assessment platform on digital TV
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Digital TV becomes a part of ordinary family life. Comparing to the traditional TV, the digital one provides better picture quality and interactive functionalities instead of just receiving one-way programs. In common families, TV takes higher generality than computers and other mobile devices. In these mentioned devices, TV is the simplest one to operate. Because of such advantages, there are many opportunities and chances in the digital TV industry. For archiving better performance on digital learning, it is necessary for integrating quiz and testing components with current e-learning systems. It is the best way to arise the learning efficiency by checking studentspsila learning achievements using test mechanism and correcting the wrong answers they made. The purpose of this paper is to develop a QTI-based Assessment Platform compliant with MHP standard on Digital TV. By this framework, users can examine how much they have learned by tests on TV and discover subjects which they are not familiar. Another objective of using TV as a tool for learning behavior is to lower threshold of domain knowledge of technologies since watching TV is a simple behavior in peoplespsila daily life.

articleTitle: Research of storage technique for C-Temporal Relation Datum Model based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As there is datum redundancy in tradition database and temporal database in existence and the quantities of temporal database are increasing fleetly. We put forward compress storage tactics basing on improved genetic algorithm for temporal datum which combine compress technology in existence in order to settle datum redundancy in the course of temporal datum storage, and this means can enhance speed of removing datum redundancy and ratio of compress for temporal datum largely. Temporal datum of slow acting domain and momentary acting domain are accessed by using each from independence clock method and mutual clock method.We also bring forward strategy of gridding storage to resolve the problems of temporal datum rising rapidly.

articleTitle: Analysis of tongue information in coronary artery disease
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To analyze the correlation between tongue inspection of coronary artery disease (CAD) and differentiation of symptoms and signs of CAD in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) as well as its clinical significance. Method: Firstly, all the patients with CAD were divided into 2 groups according to the theory of TCM: QixuXueyu (group A, n=16) and YinxuXueyu (group B, n=16) and 16 healthy people were as control group (control group, n=16). Secondly, the tongue of patient group were observed by vanguard technology method and compared with control group, such as the infrared image, thermography, tongue moisture and blood perfusion rate, to investigate the relationship between tongue inspection and the differentiation of symptoms and signs. Results: The blood oxygen degree of saturation of group A and group B is lower than the healthy control group obviously (P< 0.05). The comparison among all the group of tongue chromaticity have significantly difference. The comparison of Tongue moisture: control group >group A>group B. The blood perfusion rate of group A is lower than others. The tongue temperature was a significant rise tendency in those groups, group B >group A> control group. Conclusion: tongue information has a close relationship with the severity of CAD. Tongue inspection plays an important role in evaluating diagnosis for patients with CAD. It will absolutely advance tongue inspection of traditional Chinese medicine.

Author Keywords: tongue inspection in Traditional Chinese Medicine

articleTitle: Extra-value for e-learning systems: An e-learning standard transformation mechanism
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: There are lots of acknowledge systems involved in the e-learning environment. In order to achieve the goal of sharing and reusing the learning content generated from different educators, the common standards should be followed. More and more e- learning standards like IEEE LOM (learning object metadata), ADL SCORM (sharable content object reference model), and IMS common cartridge are developed to achieve this purpose. Besides, there are still some localized standards like UK LOM core, Can Core, TW LOM are developed according to the IEEE LOM to serve the localization needs. In this paper, we proposed a transformation mechanism to provide interoperability among these e-learning standards. Our mechanism could be regarded as a module that could be imported into any acknowledged e-learning systems. Based on this mechanism, educators will not have to re-develop the learning content to serve the systems developed from different e-learning standards.

articleTitle: UNDP403 distance education Website based on WEB2.0 CMS system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper presents a distance education Website based on WEB2.0 CMS system, which is used in the United Nations development program (UNDP) 403 project. The implementation of this project will pilot sustainable models for distance teacher education in remote rural areas in northwestern provinces The paper begins with an introduction about the UNDP 403 project initiatives and presents the system design, Struts+Hibernate+Velocity+Ajax implementation strategy of Website system, and conclusions.

articleTitle: Empowering internet users to use 6W-based learning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: 6W-based learning is a new-type of self-directed learning. This article stresses the importance of 6W-based learning. The definition of 6W- based learning is explained, and the modes, models, features, and stages of 6W- based learning are discussed. In order to empower Internet users to use 6W-based learning, some measures of enhancing 6W- based learning are provided. The authors consider that it is essential and important to develop 6W-based learning.

articleTitle: A medical image color correction method base on supervised color constancy
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To establish an acquisition and analysis method for medical image in the indoor natural light conditions; Method: According to the color characterristics of the medical image and the constancy of supervised color, we make the color codes which are used for a* b* value correction, and gray codes which are used for L* value correction. Then, we carry on topological subdivision to the one-dimensional L* space and the two-dimensional a*b* space respectively. We establish the mapping function “Decomposition-Projection-Restoration”, and ran the linear mapping to the one-dimensional L* space and triangle mapping to the two-dimensional a*b* space. We correct the 198 color blocks in 22 pictures.Result: Compared with the standard value, ΔL*, ΔC*, ΔE decreased significantly (P≪.01), image’s color difference is reduced, color saturation and the value is closer to standard value. Conclusion: TRM(Topology Resolve-Map Model) method can significantly adjust the color error of tongue images under the indoor natural light condition and easy to use, and has a good performance of color correction. It is feasible to apply this method to the color correction of the medical images.

articleTitle: The design of educational portal system based on JBoss and OpenCms
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of information technology, the amount of information about educational resources is increasing more and more. The type and form of information is rich, special on the large-scale educational portal system. The system’s visits and the amount of information are very huge. In addition, the information security has become very important. If using the traditional methods, the site can not afford the huge number of visits, the security of information resources is terrible, and by manual maintenance and management the content of the site, whose efficiency is low. In light of this situation, we have introduced the new educational portal system design model, which based on Jboss and OpenCms. By using this model, it can be a reasonable allocation of server load and ensure information security. Besides, it can organize and manage the content of the site efficiently. The editor’s work will become very convenient and efficient.

articleTitle: Design and realization of video data acquisition module based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, a generic video data acquisition module is proposed. Our module is composed of a video decoder SAA7113H and a FPGA(Field Programmable Gates Array). First, the module uses an analog CCD camera to obtain an image, which is digitized through a video decoder SAA7113H. After that, a Cyclone FPGA is used to control the acquisition of video data for subsequent image processing. We write FPGA program and perform simulation and debugging, the debugging and simulation results verify the feasibility and stability of the module.The module designed in this paper can be used as front-end video data acquisition in various image processing system.

articleTitle: e-Learning pedagogical strategies for engaging students in higher education
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The following presentation examines five e-Learning strategies for engaging students in higher education. These include: blended learning, authentic activities, problem-based learning, project-based learning and learning-oriented assessment.

articleTitle: An exploration study on student online learning behavior patterns
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The study investigated the characteristic differences among student learning behavior patterns in an online learning situation. Sixty students participated in the work and undertook four months online learning in an e-learning system. The two-stage cluster analysis was designed to explore the identification and classification of student learning behavior patterns. The results found three distinct patterns: Active Participants, Enthusiastic Participants, and Lower Participants. In addition, we found that the preliminary influences of the learning activities and the parent-child learning interaction in online learning situations might be the factors which affect student’s behavior. Finally, this study found no significant difference of learning performance among the various student behavior patterns.

articleTitle: Fast image retrieval based on color, texture and shape of MPEG-7
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Color, texture and shape are three basic visual features in content-based image retrieval. Descriptors based on only one of them could just express parts of characteristics of images. This paper proposes a method that comprehensively utilizes domain color descriptor, edge histogram descriptor and shape feature descriptor in MPEG-7 standards, and evaluates the result according to the evaluation standards provided by MPEG-7. The experiment result shows that the method combining three features does more in line with the requirements of human visual experience, and obtains better retrieval result.

articleTitle: Research of intelligent information retrieval system ontology-based in digital library
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Aim at the problem of poor retrieval quality in digital library, the advantage and correlative application of the ontology in digital library’s semantics retrieval fields was introduced. Then basic structure of semantics retrieval system based on ontology was put forward, and the ontology of constructing scientific documents was presented. Further, the process of intelligent retrieval system based on the ontology was particularly presented. After a lot of practical argumentations, the paper concluded that semantics retrieval technology would improve retrieval quality extremely, and would be the preferred method to solving the lack of semantic relation in traditional retrieval technology.

articleTitle: A MA-based Web document classification algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The amount of online document has grown greatly in recent years due to the increase in popularity of the World Wide Web. Thus, developing an efficient document classification method to automatically manipulate Web document is of great importance. A novel memetic algorithm(MA)-based document classification algorithm is presented in this paper. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm achieves much better performance than other related classification algorithms.

articleTitle: An efficient SFL-based classification rule mining algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Classification rule mining is an important data mining process that aims to discover a small set of rules from the training data set with predetermined targets. The shuffled frog leaping(SFL) algorithm, is a new robust evolutionary algorithm based on the local search and the shuffling processes. In this paper, an efficient SFL-based classification rule mining algorithm is proposed. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs much better than other related algorithms.

articleTitle: An education-oriented development framework research for business demand alteration
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper designs and implements a development framework that fits the development of educational management information system (EMIS), and provides an interface-generated user interface management system (UIMS) components and flexible permissions management modules. Considering the complex technological process of business in EMIS, we implements workflow components and rule engine modules in the development framework to support the requirements. The controller-layered encapsulation in the development framework separates the interface design from the business development phase, and reduces development difficulty of educational management information system. Based upon the development framework proposed in this paper, several typical modules in the post-graduate EMIS as enrollment, cultivation, degree and graduation management are designed and implemented. Developers can efficiently create a new educational management information system, on the proposed development framework and business modules.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of the educational resources sharing on internet base on ontology and Web services
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the in-deep researches of the heterogenic characteristic of educational resources, the platform of Web service-based Educational Resources Semantic Sharing(abbr.WERS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) is built which takes three problems of operation heterogenic, data representation heterogenic, knowledge isolation into account and utilizes web services technology, criterion building and ontology technology to realize operation interconnection, data representation unified and knowledge intercrossing. And then users could not only share the wide educational resources but also enjoy the initiatively recommendation for knowledge in WERS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Evaluating the usability of discipline repositories
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Emergence of open access repositories has extended digital libraries, while evaluation of the digital libraries has drawn great attention in recent years. Discipline repository is a major type of open repositories which have developed quickly with the open access movement. The present research proposes an evaluation criteria system and applies it to assess the usability of three selected discipline repositories, aims to find the common features of discipline repositories in usability.

articleTitle: The SCORM standard and its application in web-based education resources building
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: When developing web-based education resources, we meet new problems: resources have poor interoperability and reusability. They can’t be reused or retrieved by other systems and many resources are developed redundantly. ADL proposed the SCORM standard to solve this problem. SCORM provides a mechanism allowing content developed in one system to be shared by other SCORM-conformant systems supported by CAM, RTE and SN. The process of creating a standard SCORM courseware was discussed in detail, showing the problems which should pay attention to.

articleTitle: Proposals of making up dynamic education resources & its information fusion stations in networks based AI-technology of VCN
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper affirms a modern important method of education in networks, it is thought highly of all governments & society in the world day by day. It points that, universities in networks are some enlargement/extension of the traditional universitiespsila function, the dynamic education resources in networks are urgent need of plenty, constructing of educated information networks stations are urgent need of strengthening & improving, and it gives some proposals of making up education resources & information fusion stations in networks based AI-technology of VCN (variable carrying numbers).

articleTitle: Research and development of the onboard digital multimedia system for subway
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As using IT systems that can efficiently plan trains, manage operations and provide passengers with information, the art of state of onboard digital multimedia system is introduced. The structure and main functions of onboard digital multimedia System for subway are described. The Media Controller, audio communications, video display, content management, CCTV Surveillance and communications interface are designed in this paper. The video decoder steps and Software hierarch of Media Player are introduced. The proven complete onboard digital multimedia solutions have been successfully implemented in some city subway.The onboard digital multimedia solutions can also operate in a variety of public mass transit transportation modes.

articleTitle: On two major issues in the current network news communication
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In contrast with the other media, Internet has many advantages, for example, its transmission speed is fast, the affected range is broad, the amount of information is large, etc. However, when Internet becomes growing popularity of human social life, two problems that canpsilat be ignored appeared, which are authenticity and credibility. In view of this, we should study the characteristics of Internet news media, and make much effort to build a media platform with good image.

articleTitle: Study on body surface infrared radiation spectrum of points of patients with hyperplasia of mammary gland
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To compare the difference of body surface infrared radiation (IR) spectrum between the point Qimen (LR14), point Danzhong (CV17) and non-acupoint control point of patients with hyperplasia of mammary gland (HMG). Methods: Sixty-eight patients with HMG were enrolled in this trail. The infrared radiation spectrum of left and right point Qimen (LR14), point Danzhong (CV17) and control point were detected by the high-sensitive PHE201 body surface infrared spectrometer, the wavelength from 1.5 m to 16 m were used. Results: There were 49 wavelengths (3.50, 4.00, 4.50~16.00 m) among 59 detected wavelengths, the IR intensity of left point Qimen (LR14) was significantly higher than that of the control point (p<0.05). There were 48 wavelengths (1.75, 3.50, 4.00, 4.50~6.50, 7.00, 7.50~16.00 m) among 59 detected wavelengths, the IR intensity of right point Qimen (LR14) was significantly higher than that of the control point (p<0.05). There were 13 wavelengths ( 6.75~8.25, 9.00, 9.25, 9.75, 13.25~13.75 m) among 59 detected wavelengths, the IR intensity of point Danzhong (CV17) was significantly lower than that of the control point (p<0.05). Conclusion: The infrared radiation intensity of point Qimen (LR14) is higher than that of the control point, while the infrared radiation intensity of point Danzhong (CV17) is lower than that of the control point, which indicates that the deficiency and excess of qi and blood of points from different.

articleTitle: Application research on rough set and analytic hierarchy process in fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Aiming at disadvantages of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (CE) in weight determination, according to rough set theorem and analytic hierarchy process, a weight determination method of complete data driving is presented, and improved fuzzy CE model is obtained. At first, evaluation index system is formed according to analytic hierarchy process. Then index system is reduced effectively by the use of attribute reduction in rough set theorem, and redundant attributes are deleted. Based on the concept of inclusion degree, we define attribute importance, and present determination method of weight. According to which, fuzzy CE model is formed, therefore a new method of CE is acquired. Finally, this method is proved to be practical and feasible through examples.

articleTitle: Database of Traditional Chinese Medicinal herbs: A bridge between TCM and modern science
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As for deficiency in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM)database at present, this paper design and implement a database, discusses design principles and details of it, substructure query of chemical compounds, 2D Structure and 3D Structure display as well. This database includes prescriptions, Traditional Chinese Medicinal Herbs(TCMH), original plants of TCMH, chemical compounds of plants etc four core tables in total. Combined with semantic associations among these four tables, the whole database is an organism, which provides a good tool for research in prescriptions and Traditional Chinese Medicinal Herbs in molecular level.

articleTitle: Mobile Guardian: A novel positioning and monitoring system for outdoor special users based on GPS
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Different to traditional vehicle positioning and navigation systems, requirements of positioning operations for individuals are always contingently, and it pays more attention to making navigation devices portable and easy to use. Based on GPS and GSM, a novel positioning and monitoring system for outdoor special users called Mobile guardian is presented in this paper. Through analyzing the structure of GPS data, location-related information such as longitude and latitude of users can be extracted from GPS data stream. The GSM module which supported AT commands is used to transmit these location data and telecommands between users and the monitoring center. And the technology for encapsulating and parsing XML spacial data is utilized for Google Earth to display the detailed geographical information on the screen. Experiments show that the system is effective and could be popularized to family monitoring.

articleTitle: A differential evolutionary architecture for artificial neural trees with applications to medical data mining
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper presents an evolutionary structure for neural trees by differential evolution. For a neural tree a structure tree and weights tree are defined. A partial ordering based multi-dimensional fitness function is applied to measure the energy of the system. Different to traditional evolution method of genetic programming, a new evolution technique based on differential evolution is proposed. A numbering scheme is designed for basic operations of tree structure. Finally we present an experimental framework for the tree evolution. Application frameworks are given in medical data mining and analysis.

articleTitle: A theoretical framework of pedagogical agents based on psychological incentive mechanism and Artificial Psychology theory
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper proposes an innovative teaching and learning theoretical framework based on psychological incentive mechanism and Artificial Psychology theory. Related works about these two areas will be addressed in section 2. This framework includes three type pedagogical agents, namely the Expert agent, the Mentor agent and the Motivator agent. This framework is intended to create a positive and personalized study environment for the learners with the sufficient consideration to the learner’s emotion ingredient, learner’s personal preference and the appropriate application of the pedagogical psychology. The goal of this framework is to stimulate the learners’ internal drive to promote them to be active in the learning process.

articleTitle: Factors influencing the adoption of IT projects: A proposed model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: It is widely agreed that it is necessary for organizations to embrace and exploit information technology (IT). The fast development and broad adoption of IT have brought new business opportunities. However, mismanagement and misconduct in adopting IT often hinder successful adoption. This paper examines the critical factors that have an impact on IT adoption. Building on IT literature, a model of IT adoption is developed. This paper is significant for both researchers and practitioners, providing a new tool for them in their efforts to better understand and improve the success to failure ratio of IT adoption.

articleTitle: Study on construction of enterprise knowledge portal based on Web2.0
