publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The capability of knowledge capture and utilization becomes a key factor for a company to enhance its core competition and access to sustainable development. The ideas and technologies of Web2.0 provide better support for improving enterprise knowledge management. This paper analyzes how to integrate Web2.0 with the construction of enterprise knowledge portal, puts forward a model and architecture of Web2.0-based EKP, and proposes the technology architecture of it, expecting to have some significance and use for reference for the construction of enterprise knowledge portal.

articleTitle: Application of improved random forest variables importance measure to traditional Chinese chronic gastritis diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Many machine learning approaches have been proposed to establish the chronic gastritis diagnostic models. But till now, most of the machine-learning classifiers do not give any insight as to which features play key roles with respect to the derived classifier as well as the individual class. Recently, the variables importance measure yielded by random forest (RF) has been proposed in many applications. However, in multi-label classifications RF attempts to yield a common feature ranking for all classes, which fail in identifying the distinct predictive structures for individual class. This paper developed an improved random forest variables importance measure to evaluate the importance of features according to each individual class in multi-classification problem, and then applied a wrapper method for feature selection to construct the key features sets referring to each subtype of the chronic gastritis. Experiment results show that, compared with the previous studies, the selected features are more close to expert knowledge and contribute to better understanding of the underlying process that characterize the chronic gastritis.

articleTitle: Emotional intelligence characteristics of IT professionals in Taiwan
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study was designed to investigate emotional intelligence (EI) characteristics of undergraduate students majoring in information technology and management. It was hypothesized that significant differences existed between EI profiles of information technology students and students majoring in business administration and tourism management. Three-hundred and seventy-three students (with 178 in information technology/information management and 195 in business administration/tourism management) were selected as participants of this research. The survey used to conduct this study was Dr. Nelson and Dr. Lowpsilas-College Version. ANOVAs were used to determine different EI characteristics of undergraduate students in the two sample groups. Results of the research project have practical implications of incorporating EI into IT professional development and training program.

articleTitle: Interaction Chinese question answering system in medicine diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we propose a general framework for the interaction question answering system in medical diagnosis, which can interact simply with user to get more refined question descriptions and return answers. The system first gets FAQ pairs from cQA website, and builds the medical ontology with incremental methods. Then it analyzes the question and enquires user for the lacking information. After getting user’s feedbacks, it performs question retrieval and extracts answers. The experiment shows our system has better performance with user’s feedbacks.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of laboratory information management system based on hybrid mode
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to overcome the deficiency of the current open laboratory management information systems based on Web, in this paper we present an opened computer laboratory management information system framework based on hybrid mode, and have implemented an opened computer laboratory management information system C-LIMS. It meets the individual needs of the experiment teaching well by integrating the mobile teaching mode and the network teaching mode. At the same time experiment processes can be monitored in C-LIMS via the workflow mechanism. Practices showed that C-LIMS can meet the needs of current Universitypsilas computer laboratory management well. And in this paper, the C-LIMS architecture, SMS working mode and experimental process modeling methods are discussed.

articleTitle: Realizing extension use cases with AOP
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The extension use case adds additional behavior to a base use case without changing it. We had no mainstream programming language supporting the implementation of extensions as we now get with Aspect-Oriented Programming. Aspect-Oriented Programming provides the ability to modularize and weave the representation of crosscutting concerns. This paper focuses on the extension of UML for modeling and realizing the use case extension relationship which AOP addresses. An example of modeling and implementing extension use case with AOP is presented.

articleTitle: Prediction of student actions using weighted Markov models
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The Markov model has been applied to many prediction applications including the student models of intelligent tutoring systems. In this paper, we extend this well-known model to the weighted Markov model, and then apply it to student models in order to predict student behaviors. The prediction using our models is based not only on the frequency of collective behaviors of previous users, but also on the degrees of the relations between the predicted user and others. In doing so, a novel way is presented to quantify the similarities between previous students and the current active student. These similarity scores will be used as weights in the weighted Markov model.

articleTitle: Server load prediction based on improved support vector machines
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To provide e-learning service more efficiently and effectively, Data mining technique have been applied in web-based distance education such as personalized service provision, server load prediction, etc. In web-based e-learning system, web server is the key and core component. In this paper, a novel server load prediction model is put forward by employing Support Vector Machines (SVM). In addition, an approach to select free parameters of SVM is introduced which select parameters by checking if the training residual is white noise. Theoretical analysis and Experimental result has shown that by using this approach, server load prediction with high precision can be achieved.

articleTitle: An evaluation of TDD training methods in a programming curriculum
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper evaluates an innovative training method which is based on TDD (test driven development) [4] and implemented in an automatic online judge system named DICE [9]. After running the automatic grading system DICE at Hsin Kuo High School in Taiwan for years, we found that some students were left out by the DICE system. We needed a more sophisticated mechanism to assist under achievers. Our solution was to utilize TDD as an extension of the DICE system to promote learning performance in programming. We implemented DICE with TDD and have applied the innovative training method in the programming curriculum at Hsin Kuo High School in Taiwan for one semester. Simultaneously we conducted an experiment with a control and experimental group to estimate the efficiency of DICE with TDD. Our finding is that DICE with TDD improves the mean scores of learners by 50.88% over the control group.

articleTitle: UIMwiki: An enhanced semantic wiki for user information management
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The application of semantic wikis in user information management for purpose of personalization is investigated in this paper. It presents an enhanced semantic wiki, named UIMwiki, aiming to combine artificial psychology and user annotation in a semantic wiki system for user information management. Wiki users in UIMwiki are classified into three groups: end users, expert users and ontologists. There are two ways to maintain user information in UIMwiki for an end user: executing a cognitive query or adding semantic annotations. A user model based on artificial psychology can be built from the cognitive query files by a user model generator. The user model generator gives user model suggestions based on psychology knowledge and Quantification Theory I.UIMwiki considers userpsilas implicit information or knowledge in the annotation process and it makes the personalization more effectively.

articleTitle: An intelligent test sheet composition system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Computer-based tests have been proven to be more effective and efficient than traditional paper-and-pencil tests, so more and more examinations begin to offer computerized form, taking the Professional Qualification Examination for example. In this paper, according to the item bank and composition rules in the Professional Qualification Examination, we propose an intelligent test sheet composition system to generate the test sheet automatically. The test sheets composed by this system can not only meet the composition rules but also be different even if the same rule.

articleTitle: Realization of a new-style fingerprint recognition system based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A new-style fingerprint recognition system which is based on DSP and RF-card is proposed in this paper. The new system adopts the way of comparing the new captured fingerprint image to the fingerprint characteristics which can be read from the RF-card. The matching time is much shorter than former embedded system which used to compare the captured fingerprint image to each fingerprintpsilas characteristics which are stored in flash memory or other memory. In addition, a Power Switch Module, which can automatic switch the ways of power supply between wall adapter and batteries, is proposed in this paper. The new fingerprint recognition system has the characteristics of low power, low cost and high performance.

articleTitle: Reducing redundancy in XML Keyword Search by indirect-SLCA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of the data redundancy in XML Keyword Search by SLCA and propose a new mode to resolve it. We begin by introducing the notion of SLCA and analyzing its faults. Then we propose the concept of Indirect-SLCA (ISLCA) to reduce the redundancy basing on the notion of Heterogeneous node. In order to speed up the computation of ISLCA, we improve the Dewey code by bring in the labelpsilas information. And we name the new one LDC. At last we give an Algorithm to compute the ISLCA.

articleTitle: Research on several questions in CG case teaching system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article discusses the computer graphicspsila fundamentality and questions exiting in computer graphicspsila curriculum teaching. It presents a basic train of thoughts of educational reform based on the case teaching in computer graphics. The paper expounds research aims, research contents and implementation methods. And it initially proposes a new model about the computer graphicspsila teaching system based on cases. The case design, the case teaching practice, and the case material compilation and so on which are related to case teaching have been planed. Especially, in the aspect of the case design, a mentality of knowledge analysis and case design in computer graphics is proposed.

articleTitle: The research of digital publishing resources management in China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As the progress of information society, the digital publishing with the core of network publishing and e-book has brought a great reformation to global publishing industry. And the research on the management of digital publishing resource is more important than before. This paper discusses about the definition, characteristics, reference fields and application of digital publishing resource, based on analysis of the literature about the management of digital publishing resource. Some management means are suggested against the problems existed in management of digital publishing resource.

articleTitle: On training of news communication talents under network condition
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With fast development of media industry in our country in recent years, the demand for media talents is increasing and the model for talent training in the sector of news and communication has been transformed. The training of talents in this field needs to follow the development trend of domestic press industry. So attentions should be paid to changes in development in this industry so as to establish comprehensive ways of talent training and to train talents of multiple capabilities. In addition, theoretical research, teachers training and investment in this field should be strengthened with the aim of training highlevel talents that are capable, adaptive and innovative and socially needed.

articleTitle: New PID controllers for step response of robot manipulators with an uncertain Jacobian matrix
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In framework of PID controllers, there is only three parameters available to tune, as a result, performance of the resulting system is always limited. As for cartesian regulation of robot manipulators with uncertain Jacobian matrix, a new scheme of PID controllers is proposed to improve performance for step response. Compare with the traditional PID controllers, a time-dependent integration is employ in this proposed controller to improve performance.

articleTitle: An exploration of Social network analysis on cohesion in online collaborative learning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Cohesion is one of key factors influencing the performance of collaborative learning. But it is hart to reckon and assess it in online collaborative learning environments. Social network analysis (SNA) is a new method and technique analyzing the properties of the interaction relations between participants. In this paper, we introduced the related key concepts in SNA, and presented an analysis model which can analyze the cohesion of groups effectively and precisely, and then showed a case study which was from a quasi-experiment in our instruction practice, lastly, drew several useful principles on reckoning cohesion in online collaborative learning by SNA.

articleTitle: An examination of the effectiveness of group learning in a blended learning environment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To examine the effectiveness of group learning is an important issue which it can help us to know how well group learning works, especially in a blended learning environment. 20 students participated in this study and questionnaire survey and focus group interviews are used for collecting data to analyze those issues. A combined quantitative and qualitative approach is employed to examine those issues. Results demonstrate that group learning is effective and studentspsila attitudes toward it are positive.

articleTitle: The application of the associative memory model in the blood tests
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: For finding some diseases (such as the leukemia) in time and avoiding missed diagnosis in the traditional way, this paper presents the application of the associative memory model in the blood tests. We use blood test instruments to do blood routine examination on body at first, then extract the eigenvectors based on the clinical significance and the range of every parameter, and finally send it to the associative memory model.

articleTitle: A genetic algorithm approach to location-allocation problem in Urban Garbage Logistics System
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: How to save the cost of collection and transportation is one of the biggest problems in the urban garbage logistics system. In this paper, a model has been set up to minimize the system operation cost, and a genetic algorithm was developed to work this model out. Experimental studies show that the GA generates approximate optimal solutions very quickly and good-quality solutions can be obtained on an acceptable computational cost.

articleTitle: Knowledge discovery of chronic gastritis diagnosis by logistic discriminant analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Logistic regression has been increasingly used in chronic gastritis research. Using expression of logistic discriminant analysis monitored simultaneously by Logit transformation, contribution of gastritis symptom to the certain specific features are distinguished, and chronic gastritis samples are more accurately classified. While Logistic discriminant analysis has been extensively evaluated for dichotomous classification, there are only limited reports on the important issue of multi-class chronic gastritis classification. It needs to explore the logistic discriminant analysis of the multi-class chronic gastritis classification. This research utilizes Logistic discriminant analysis to analyze four kinds of main symptoms of chronic gastritis patient: Belch, the body is tired and weak (weakness), stomachache (ache) and the bloated state of stomach (stomach bloated) severity with sex, age is related, the probability of a kind of patientpsilas symptom severity appears with the estimation, the knowledge discovery is confirmed. The result presents that the probability that the stomach bloated is normal rather than moderate, man are of womenpsilas 1.838 times.

articleTitle: An integrated management platform for network and server
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In the network center, there are various devices and servers to form a part of infrastructure for education. It’s a challenge for network operator center. This platform provides a integrated management and monitor approach for network devices and circumjacent services. It uses the Browser/Server model, we can use any browser to manage and montior the network devices, such as router, switch, and server. Now it supports most of popular switche and routers, DNS and DHCP services.

articleTitle: The research on usability evaluation of e-learning systems
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper reports the research and practice on the usability assessment of e-learning systems and is intended to enhance the process of knowledge acquisition in daily classroom settings. The applied scenario-based usability evaluation, as a combination of behavior and opinion based measurements, enabled to quantify usability in terms of userspsila (teacherspsila and studentspsila) performance and satisfaction. According to the achieved results, the main directions for interface redesign are offered.

articleTitle: The aesthetic meaning in design of graphics system of virtual scenes —taking the design of virtual driving simulator on graphics system of mountain scenes for example
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: the combination of art with science and esthetics with technology has been a new bright point of this centry. According to that, this paper illustrates the aesthetic meaning in graphics system of virtual scenes, it takes the design of virtual driving simulator on the graphics system of mountain scenes for example. It aims to amend the aesthetic defection in pure technology. The paper also discusses deeply on the accession problem about aesthetic meaning in design of system, it has practically strong meaning for aesthetics.

articleTitle: Using gateway to implement hierarchical recovery protocol in wide area network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Checkpoint and Message logging as an effective and transparent recovery method usually are implemented in LAN. With the development of scale in distributed system, computing nodes are located differently in geography. Fault tolerance and scalability problems are a real challenging work in wide area environment, because the length of wrapped message is increasing based on the node numbers. Some improved methods have brought false dependable problem and caused the system to roll back additionally. We proposed a scheme in which besides exchanging inter-domain messages by gateway two-dimensional state vector is used to divide and track the dependency. By the means the false dependency avoided. The proposed scheme can not only employ hierarchy gateways but also composite recovery protocols, so it can adapt to complexity situation of distributed system in wide area network.

articleTitle: The approaches to promote the efficiency of IT in medical information treatment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Computer has been becoming the tools of medical works. IT becomes more and more critical for hospital staffs. But the development between IT system in hospital and increase of clinic medical practitioner is not equal. So, to enforce new ideas and collaboration between researchers and practitioners is very important at this stage. Therefore, we select procedure chain about a CAD patient to discuss how to adopt information technology to medical information system reform, integrate decentralized IT resources, improve the quality of medical services and to control to reduce the expense for patients. Based on our survey, We provide some views concerned about IT applying in medical procedures in China at present.

articleTitle: Research and reform on computer network practical teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on the development of computer network curriculum, it is necessary to implement curriculum development reform to strengthen the practical teaching. Then discusses the organization and system structure of the practical courses, and gives the practical tache implementation. Finally, introduces the implementation results of computer network practical teaching in our school.

articleTitle: Function Bidirectional S-Rough Sets and Bellman principle realize knowledge measure
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Function bidirectional S-rough sets realizes dynamic template matching between reference template and test template, then calculates the Levenstein distance with dynamic programming algorithm of Bellman principle and finds the knowledge distance measure which can reduce the compute complexity greatly.

articleTitle: Intelligent document technology in university educational administration management system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: University educational administration management system begins to shift the workflow to the electronic document from the paper document workflow. However, the forms are difficult to be integrated into the existing workflow since improving and submitting forms are of low efficiency. The appearance of the intelligent document technology makes flexible document information interchanges become possible. Combined with PDF document standards, technologies of SOA, web services and XML, we propose a framework of university educational administration management system based on SOA. In this framework design, we take forms as the centre of system, adopt the intelligent document technology to integrate data gathering, business process, subsystem applications and data storing.

articleTitle: Enabling technology and mechanism for knowledge building in synergistic learning environment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Synergistic learning technology system is a new learning environment with collaborative annotation and visual knowledge mapping. With experimentation and verbal protocol method, this paper analyzed the learner’s knowledge building dynamics in the learning process under the research context supported by synergistic learning technology system. The result shows the learning system worked well on the learner group who has unbalanced knowledge building ability in different phases of synergistic learning. The influence is more obvious during information sharing and comparison stage. Synergistic learning technology system has realized collective knowledge building and graphical representation of collective memory.

articleTitle: Research and practice of multi-dimensional teaching of “Management Information System”
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: From the teaching practices of management information system, this paper puts forward the concept of multi-dimensional teaching of management information system, and discusses the way and methods to establish multi-dimensional teaching mode from the aspects of teaching philosophy, teaching content, selection of teaching materials, teaching methods, teaching means, examination and evaluation.

articleTitle: The design and realization of Template-based Network Course Creator
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Network course building becomes an important issue of university subject construction, but complicated Web page and Web site creating technologies restrict its development. This paper proposes a framework to design and develop a Template-based Network Course Creator which can assist users to develop a network courseware and create an integral network course. It unchains the technological bondages, quickens the development of the network course, and improves the network course quality.

articleTitle: Minimization of PTQ under XSCs
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: XML is the standard for data representation and exchange over the Web. XSC is a concept of a pattern-based XML schema formalism. It models some structural constraints. Since the pattern tree is widely used in XML queries and the query efficiency depends on the size of the pattern, it is essential to minimize the size of the pattern tree. We consider the problem of minimization of pattern tree queries (PTQ) under some structural constraints for XML (XSCs). This is a new research field. This research can improve the query efficiency on some XML database with some structural constraints. In this paper, we study pattern tree minimization when taking XSCs into consideration. We develop a polynomial time algorithm called XSCM on this purpose. We complement our analytical results with an experimental study that shows the effectiveness of our pattern tree techniques.

articleTitle: Computer-aided teaching and evaluation system oriented Programming Laguage
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The Programming Language is always been thought of as one of the difficult disciplines to learn, simultaneously the freshmen usually tend not to lay enough emphasis on the learning of it. The paper is to design a computer-aided teaching system for students’ daily study, and to evaluate students’ usual study based on the fuzzy appraisal method, to set up the appraise sets, to obtain the weight of appraisal factor using the analysis hierarchy process (AHP) method, which can not only solve the subjectivity of judging regular performance, but also motivate and spur the students’ learning enthusiasm, and reduce teacher’s work load.

articleTitle: An agent-based assessing system in data structure course
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The research work on e-learning has become very important field in the education. This paper proposes a method to build a Bayesian networks model in order to assess the learnerpsilas knowledge level in data structure course. This e-learning assessing system is designed and implemented based on multi-agent systems. In this paper, an overlay student model based on Bayesian networks is presented. This student modeling is built on organization relationships and dependency relationships among the knowledge items with Bayesian networks. In the data structure course, the dependency relationships among the knowledge items are reflected in this overlay model and the dependency relationships will decide the prediction ability of this model. A case study in data structure course is illustrated in this paper.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional reconstruction of human median, ulnar and radial nerve
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This study was undertaken to implement the three-dimensional (3D) reconstruction of the intraneural structure in the upper limb peripheral nerves. Three fresh cadaver peripheral nerves (one median, one ulnar and one radial nerve) were located with human hair, embedded in OCT, sectioned consecutively every 100 mum at a 20 mum thickness. Then all slices were stained with the acetylcholinesterase histochemical (AChe) method. 2D information of these slices were obtained through high resolution scanner. A special software (3D nerve visualization system) was used for 3D reconstruction of these nerves. Finally, 3D microstructure inside these nerves were reproduced in the computer. 3D nerve visualization system can show exactly the 3D microstructure inside these nerves and the rules of the regrouping and redistribution of the fasciculus. In addition, the reconstructed nerves could rotate at any angle along any axis, which might help us to observe the shape, position and relationships of fasciculus from different positions. It might do a great help to provide a anatomic basis for the approach in treating peripheral nerve injuries.

articleTitle: Scalable distributed information retrieval model based on topic map and mobil agent
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In view of the problems of centralized search engine and based on analyzing the technology of topic map, OAI, mobile Agent and P2P, we design and implement a Scalable Distributed Retrieval Model based on Topic Map and Mobile Agent. The model can effectively improve the utilization rate of resources, increase search depth, overcome server failure and heterogeneity of network, and has a strong capacity for expansion, fault-tolerant and parallel processing

articleTitle: Virtual classroom environment using low bandwidth PSTN
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper describes system architecture for peer to peer multimedia communication using low bandwidth lines such as PSTN. The intent of this research work is to provide multimedia lectures at remote areas where broadband internet access to students is not available or prohibitively expensive. The system attempts to mitigate the shortage of qualified instructors in far flung areas. Existing telecommunications infrastructure based on low bandwidth PSTN lines has been employed for delivering text, audio, live camera and slides to remote sites in real-time. The system is developed using Microsoft TAPI (telephony application programming interface) for establishing peer to peer connection between any two remote terminals. Paper includes details of complete system development including the GUI, data capture and communication mechanism.

articleTitle: A bitmap indexing scheme for temporal access control to XML documents
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As more and more sensitive information gets stored in the form of XML, proper access control to the XML documents becomes increasingly important. Moreover, XML documents may be available to users at certain time periods, and unavailable at others. To tackle such dynamic aspects, this paper proposes a bitmap-indexing scheme in which timed access control decisions can be effectively processed. The form (Auth<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</sub>, Auth<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o</sub>) is used to present authorization policies which are encoded as bitmaps in the same manner as XML document indexes are constructed.

articleTitle: A graduate cultivation and management pattern with the support of new informationization
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper sets foot on actual states of Chinese graduate cultivation, analyses new features and problems in the process of cultivating reformation, and brings forward an intensive talent cultivation pattern based on informationization system. On the basis of general introduction of technical and functional framework of Graduates Management Information System of Shandong University, it mainly introduces some important functions of this system, such as process management, status control, data support, online teaching and so on.

articleTitle: A case study of nanokernel in education
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to make the operating system in education easier to understand and practice, we advise to introduce a kind of nanokernel to the beginner because the concept of nanokernel was to reduce the kernel to basic schedular, interrupt and timer, and let others reside in user space in forms of normal processes. XtratuM as a special nanokernel is a part of OCERA(Open Components for Embedded Real-time Application) project in Europe. A feature of XtratuM is that it can realize executing several operating system in the same hardware. As a nanokernel with less than 5000 lines source codes, XtratuM has its prospects in resolving complex requirements in embedded developing area. it is worth a try to introduce XtratuM as an instructional operating system.

articleTitle: A web page templates based multi-mode management system for excellent course application
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The management for excellent course application has become very important in universitiespsila teaching affairs. However, the traditional working mode is not competent for such affairs. In this paper, a Web page templates based multi-mode management system for excellent course application is proposed to solve the problem. The system adopts both C/S and B/S modes to improve its performance, and makes use of Web page templates to facilitate users producing canonical application pages and administration handling the applications.

articleTitle: A model transformation classification method used in QVT
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Aiming at potential pitfalls concerning interactivity and consistency of model driven development, this paper provides a new method of model transformation classification named MTCM. The method analyses the differences between the modeling language, the modeled system and the model itself, then makes a fine-granularity classification of model transformation based on the analyze. Afterwards, the classification is applied to the research of the model transformation standard Query/View/Transformation(QVT), which proposed by OMG together with Model Driven Architecture(MDA), and one of its classic example of the model transforming process from Ecore model to Kermeta model have been evaluated and verified critically. With the conclusion of analyzing QVT with the classification, we believe that understanding the MTCM method deeply is an important prerequisite for improving the veracity and efficiency of model transformation.

articleTitle: Research of video error concealment algorithm for the remote education system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Remote education is a new education mode which can train people all over the world by providing teaching videos. This paper presents an efficient error concealment algorithm for H.264, which we use in the decoder of the video player to improve teaching video quality. In the proposed algorithm, first considering the character of teaching video, estimate the error macro block (MB) belongs to foreground or background; if the error MB belongs to background, we replace the error MB by copying the MB in the reference frame, else, we introduce Lagrange algorithm and decoder motion-vector estimation algorithm (DMVE) to estimate the optimal motion vector (MV), and replace the error MB with which has the optimal MV. Results demonstrate that proposed algorithm provides better performance than the conventional algorithm, which improves teaching video quality.

articleTitle: Construction of distributed cache mechanism in database laboratorial curriculum design
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of Internet Technology, in most universities and colleges, the education researches and innovation about professional curriculum of computer science & technology have occurred continually. In our database laboratorial curriculum design, we put forward higher requirements with the performance in decision support system (DSS). In order to improve the query response-time in DSS, this paper proposes a new DSS architecture with distributed cache mechanism, gives the working flow of the system, and introduces an admission & replacement algorithm. Experimental results show that the system performance is favorable.

articleTitle: Performance optimization for SMP cluster operation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this project, there is high performance SMP(symmetric multiprocessing) cluster platform is connected by Gigabit Ethernet and Infiniband net. On the platform the programming model of mixing OpenMP software and MPI software not only increase the parallelism and execution efficiency of the correlator of SMP cluster, but also improve system performance effectively, the speedup will become higher.

articleTitle: On bridging the digital gap of informatization construction of academic affairs management
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Based on an investigation into the current situation of constructing informatization of university academic affairs management, this paper, from the perspective of social informatics, analyzes the digital gap of current informatization construction of academic affairs management, and discusses the problem of how to promote continuous and steady development of informatization construction of university academic affairs management

articleTitle: Effect of Natural Brain-Kenetine on variance of Gene expression profiles in MSC and hippocampus of AD rats analyzed by Gene chips and bioinformatics techniques
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To explore the difference of gene expression in rat mesenchymal stem cell (MSC) and in the hippocampus of the Alzheimerpsilas disease (AD) model rats on Natural Brain-Kinetine by Gene chips. Methods: Rat MSC is primary cultured according to method-routie. The MSCs have two groups, the control group and treatment group without or with Natural Brain-Kinetine (NBK) respectively. MSCs gene expression is detected and analyze through the Affymetrix microarray. In addition, we analyze the gene expression in hippocampus of rats. The rats were randomly divided into 3 groups : sham group, AD model group (injected 25 mug Amyloid peptide beta<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-40</sub> in bilateral hippocampus), AD model treatment group. They were fed for 30 days with nature salt solution and Natural Brain-Kinetine respectively. Results: In MSCs, the expression of 18 genes are significantly increased (FC > 2) and lower of 28 genes (FC <-2) compared with the control group. The animal experiments show that in treatment group, there is 58 genes up regulated and 25 genes down regulated compared with the sham group, there is 15 genes up regulated and 28 genes down regulated compared with the AD model group. Those genes are possible involved the ones including cellular proliferation, cell differentiation and development, cell adhesion, nerve growth, cellular function regulation, cell signal transduction, cellular material and energy metabolism, immune response, and so on. Conclusion: We speculate that Natural Brain-Kinetine can regulate some target genes in the growth and differentiation of MSCs, and regulate hippocampus function in rats with a multi pathway to regulate the function of brains.

articleTitle: Exploration of tongue coating protein based on proteomics assessment and bioinformatics analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To observe the coating of tongue to identify the diagnosis and explore its mechanisms at molecular level by using proteomics techniques. Method: Subjects were divided into four groups: normal thin and whitish coating group, patho-thin coating group, thick coating group and exfoliative coating group according to the presentation of the coating of tongue and with or without system organic diseases; two-dimension electrophoresis was conducted with immobilized pH gradients as first-dimension and vertical SDS-PAGES as second dimension. Proteins expressional signal were examined by sliver staining and image analysis of ImageMaster 2D Platinum software. Proteins altered in expressional level were digested by trypsin. The peptide mass fingerprint was identified by MALDI-TOF MS/MS. Result: The results of protein spots in these four groups were 1082plusmn105, 1052plusmn85, 1129plusmn98 and 1143plusmn140 respectively. According to the analysis of those selective protein spots by mass spectrometry and bioinformatics studies, 13 proteins closely related to tongue coating had been found, among which cystatin B, cytokeratin 13 and GAL7 protein were found for first time, which were closely related to the changes of tongue coating. Furthermore, there were 5 new proteins identified, which have not been recorded in the international Protein Data Bank till today, of which the biological effect needs to be further explored. Conclusion: The research method for tongue coating on the basis of proteomics and bioinformatics was feasible. The protein profile present significantly difference between patho-tongue coating and normal tongue coating. Deep research on proteomics of tongue coating may hopefully become the scientific proof and microcosmic index of clinic diagnosis of traditional Chinese medicine, evaluation of herbal pharmaceutical effect, method for screening new drugs and exploring their pharmacodynamics.

publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education

articleTitle: Research and practice on new interactive teaching model based on constructivist learning theory
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A new interactive information transmission model of teaching based on the constructivist learning theory is created and studied in this paper. According to the different classification of knowledge, how to play the different functions of the information transmission channels? How to apply the information technology in the interactive teaching model? Those problems are solved. The application principles and methods of the information technology are proposed. An Example is give to show the application of the interactive teaching model in practical teaching.

articleTitle: WHU-XML: An XML based digital library system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As a semi-structured data standard rich in both content and structure, XML is becoming the dominant information organization format in digital library. Compared with traditional information retrieval systems, XML retrieval system has great advantages in organizing and retrieving information due to its element-level rather than document-level access to relevant information. This paper gives a detailed introduction of an XML-based digital library system named WHU-XML, including the indexing of XML documents and image data, the retrieval of information and the presentation of search results.

articleTitle: Study on the user behavior of digital library with Cosine Similarity Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper constructs an architectural model of database gateway, which can monitor and record the data flow between users and databases of digital library. Then it introduces cosine Similarity Algorithm, and proposes COS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DCSU</sub>, (DCSU, databases choice stickiness of user) to present the similarity of choice tendency in user pairs. Furthermore, it discusses the Interval Probability distribution of COS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DCSU</sub> values (IPDCV), and explores the application of IPDCV distribution characteristic while librarians making decisions.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a Personal Digital Library platform
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Personal digital library(PDL) plays an important role in learning, working and daily life. The paper proposes a model of PDL according to its functions. The model includes data layer, service layer, assistant layer. The PDL can be interactive with public library or digital repository. After analyzing current tools suitable for building personal digital library and their deficiency in details, the author explores some work that should be done in the future to make personal digital library work well.

articleTitle: Method for predicting clinical state of disease based on information technology on diagnosis in chinese medicine
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: To study the method for prognosis based on diagnostic information technology in Chinese medicine, Chinese ancient technology of the Heavenly Stems and generation-restrain among five elements. Method to get the method for diagnosis and prognosis in clinical practice of Chinese medicine based on the conception of correspondence between nature and human. The method is deducted from the diagnostic technology of inspection, listening and smelling, inquiry and pulse-taking in clinical practice of Chinese medicine, Chinese ancient Heavenly Stems and generation-restrain among five elements. Method based on four diagnostic methods including inspection, listening and smelling, inquiry and pulse-taking: inspection, listening and smelling, inquiry and pulse-taking are all important and they need to be applied integratedly in clinical practice. Method for predicting based on generating and restrain among five elements: disease is deteriorated when the corresponding qi of the morbid viscus is not in predominant and alleviated in predominant Method for predicting based on exuberance and debility of yin and yang: exuberance and debility of yin and yang are essential to explain the etiology in Chinese medicine. The ancient doctors put emphasis especially on method for predicting state of disease based on exuberance and debility of yang. Method for predicting based on generating digits: the generating digits were used by ancient people to describe the exuberance and debility of yin and yang and illustrate the law of transformation and generation of all things on earth: the benign and malign prognosis of disease can be predicted according to heavenly and earthly digits which generate viscera as well as ten Heavenly Stems and twelve Earthly Branches and generation-restrain among five elements. The diagnostic information technology in Chinese medicine, Chinese ancient technology of the Heavenly Stems and generation-restrain among five elements are significant in prognosis.

articleTitle: Development of the Parkinson’s Disease System for Chinese Medicine Diagnosis Based on Database
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To study the Parkinson's disease system for Chinese medicine diagnosis based on database. Method: We will screen the Diagnosis factor and kinds of syndromes by using of modern mathematical or statistical methods and establish the respective database on the basis of the Modern Literature Research of the syndromes of Traditional Chinese Medicine of PD. The system is under the guidance of the theory of TCM. Result: According to the 52 literatures that are statisticed. There are 190 kinds of syndromes and 42 kinds of different syndromes. The most common syndromes of TCM about Parkinson's Disease are yin deficiency of liver and kidney, deficiency of qi and blood, stirring wind due to phlegm-heat, qi stagnation and blooad stasis and endogenous wind. As the symptom analysis results, we can see that There are 151 kinds of different symptoms in the 52 literatures. Trembling, dyskinesia, pose abnormality, myotony are four main symptoms which appears most frequently. Except that, (Eliminates tongue, pulse condition) the frequency precedes mainly has dizziness, lack of power with limbs, insomnia and dreaminess, numbness of limbs, dim complexion, stupid vitality, anorexia, soreness and weakness of waist and knees, dry stool, tired spirits, spontaneous perspiration; red tongue, pale tongue, white musci, greasy fur are the most frequently tough images, while microsphygmy, wiry pulse, feeble pulse are the most prequently pulses. There are 96 kinds of symptoms to inquiry; 40 to inspection and 15 to Pulse-Taking and Palpation in all of the symptoms. lt will develop the minimum standards of diagnosis of syndromes of Traditional Chinese Medicine for PD ,which its features is under the guidance of the theory of TCM and emboding syndromes Differetiation of TCM theory, so that the syndromes Differetiation of Traditional Chinese Medicine have accomplished intelligence. Conclusion: The Prototype of this System that is concerned with the computer technique, intelligent information processing technology and Traditional Chinese Medicine theory is feasible and have accomplished intelligence.

articleTitle: Classification association rules mining for Zhongjing prescriptions
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Zhongjing prescriptions have experienced approximately two thousand years of Clinical verification. The prescriptions are commended by the later generation as classical prescriptions because of strict compatibility and remarkable treatment result. So Zhongjing prescriptions are selected as data set in this paper. A classification association rules mining algorithm based on information gain feature selection CARM-IG is achieved, which is used to mine compatibility principles of Zhang Zhongjing for the treatment of cold zheng, heat zheng, deficiency zheng and excess zheng etc. Experiments show that the run time and memory cost of algorithm is reduced, at the same time, the concision and precision of classification compatibility principles is guaranteed because of the deletion of irrelevant Chinese medicines with classification.

articleTitle: Multi-granularity time-constraint Role-based access control
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The research work of basic Role-based access control RBAC is greatly emphasized in recent years. However, many of present works have nothing to do with the time character. After detail analysis about the RBAC 2004 model, a new RBAC model with multi-granularity time character called MG-TRBAC is proposed. In our new access control model, user, object, permission and roles are all temporal sensitive. Time constraints are measured by more than one granularity and can be implemented implicitly. The most interesting character in our access control model is that MG-TRBAC can adjust the minimum time unit threshold automatically; therefore, our access control model can save time and computational work deeply and efficiently.

articleTitle: New educational concept student status management system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper is based on our schoolpsilas new academic affairs management system, which aims to improve efficiency of teaching and learning, using IT technologies. Considering the limitation of old system and new requirements for this system, according to our schoolpsilas new educational concept, the lightweight j2ee framework is chose. In this paper, a new student status management system will be introduced and also the main creative implement technologies based on the new requirements. Compared with the old system, the new one has a good performance with high stability, maintainability and reusability, using structs, hibernate and spring-so called lightweight framework.

articleTitle: Research on suprathreshold stochastic resonance of FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron model
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nowadays, noise was considered to play a key role in the neural system, which improved the weak signal detection and enhanced the information transmission, as deeply research on stochastic resonance (SR). Traditionally, stochastic resonance was thought to be the result of the interaction between subthreshold signals with noise in nonlinear system. Particularly, the existence of noise was thought to be harmful to the response of system with suprathreshold signal input commonly. Observing the response of FitzHugh-Nagumo (FHN) neuron model to the suprathreshold input, it was improved gradually as the amplitude of input rising from subthreshold to suprathreshold. Signal-to-noise ratio and cross correlation coefficient were defined as performance evaluation functions separately, then the response of FHN neuron model to periodic and aperiodic suprathreshold signal input was studied. At the same time, the threshold characteristic was discussed, and some basic parameters for practical application were provided. The simulation result illustrates the information transmission can be enhanced by the noise even if input signal is suprathreshold in FHN neuron model.

articleTitle: Wavelet based De-noising of pulse signal
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper discussed the principle and method of Wavelet De-noising, reduced noise of pulse signal based on wavelet. It is shown that wavelet de-noising can eliminate most noise, and preserve effectively sudden change of signal. This paper analyzed and compared the effect of de-noising of pulse signal in different ways and means, in different kinds of wavelet basis and different kinds of threshold. All study shows de-noising of pulse signal based on wavelet have practical value.

articleTitle: Architecture for BPEL based requirement driven learning management
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With support of multiple learners and multiple roles in a learning activity, IMS Learning Design (LD) specification provides a collaborative scenario for participants. However, IMS LD provides insufficient support for interaction among learning activities and can not dynamically integrate learning resources to meet the continually changing service requirement. In this paper, we propose a BPEL-enhanced requirement driven learning management architecture to address the issues of personalize adaptive learning. Our approach models the learning activity by combining IMS LD with BPEL and matches optimal learning sequence base on CBR (Case-based reasoning) method. By providing expandable learning sequences flexibly, it satisfies the different actual demands for personalize learning.

articleTitle: Teaching Quality Evaluation Approach Based on SVM
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper presents a novel evaluation approach of the teaching quality based on support vector machines (SVMs). Firstly, the evaluation index selection and the teaching quality levels are provided. Secondly, the teaching quality evaluation approach including the four evaluation indexes and three ranks based on one-against-one mode of SVM is proposed. Finally, simulation results are presented to demonstrate the feasibility of the evaluation approach.

articleTitle: A novel approach for simulating peer-to-peer based ALM using ns2
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we proposed a novel approach for simulating peer-to-peer (P2P) based application layer multicast (ALM) using ns2. This study also can be used in other simulations of P2P application. Simulation environments and approaches for evaluating and investigating overlay network or P2P application are very important. Better simulation result can accelerate research and deployment of new overlay network and application in P2P. Researchers can compare their works with other peoplepsilas research and find a way to improve it easily. We construct a simulation environment via extending ns2 for accomplishing above mentioned objects, through the modifying of application agent we built and generating of network topology using gt-itm embedded in ns2, metrics and processes in P2P overlay network such as delay, control overhead, node join, leave, failure and fault recovery, can be simulated easily and enough statistical data gathered. Finally, we simulated our recent work through this novel approach.

articleTitle: Idea and practice for paperless education of Mechanical Engineering Drawing
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The desirability and feasibility of paperless education in curriculum of Mechanical Engineering Drawing are discussed in this paper. Three measures are adapted in the whole education cycle and. A set of web-based multimedia teaching material provides teacher to give his/her lecture in classroom vividly and a legible electrical reading book after school. An assignment system is an interactive toolkit for teacher to organize, publish and check students’ assignments, also for student to download and submit his/her schoolwork and check their own study state. A virtual collaborative discussion platform is a genial environment for discussing interested topics on net, specially for engineering drawing. The geometrical dispersed people can view same drawing on their own browsers, directly modify or create the entities in the drawing, and the operating results can display synchronously on all the browsers. Realization of the system foretells a bright prospect of paperless education of Mechanical Engineering Drawing.

articleTitle: A method using workflow based on roles and rules to compose components
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Recently the technology of CBSD(component-based software development) and workflow become research focus, and they are important in software development. CBSD is a method of building system from down to up, which builds models for each subsystem ignoring the interaction among them, then composes all the subsystems to form the entire system. Workflow describes the relationship among business actions ignoring the details of business actions. Based on workflow technology and components technology, this paper focuses on a method using workflow based on roles and rules to compose components, and analyzes the details of all kinds of key elements such as roles assignment, rules builds and uses, and the method of using roles and rules in workflow.

articleTitle: IT-trends under the aspect of medicine and education: Technologies and scenarios
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The presentation addresses a selection of recent IT-trends and views them under the aspect of medicine and education: 1) Web 2.0, 2) Web 3.0, 3) Web services, 4)service oriented architecture (SOA), 5) telematics, 6) mobile devices.

articleTitle: Application of the optical correlator in the medical image registration
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Medical image registration, which is the precondition of medical image fusion, is a highlight of present medical image processing, and has important values in clinical diagnosis and treatment. To match the medical images with low SNR, the joint transform correlator is used to measure the image motion between the serial images. The principle of this method is described, then the experiment is done by using some medical images. The results showed that, the joint transform correlator can measure the sub-pixel image shifts entirely even for the images with SNR=1, and mean square deviation of the measurement error no more than 0.2 pixels.

articleTitle: Tilting alignment for electron tomography based on local cross-correlation and adaptive searching
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Understanding three-dimensional (3D) structure of components ranging from molecules to cells can help to understand the biological function of viruses. Accurate image alignment is needed for computing 3D reconstruction from transmission electron microscope tilt series. In this paper, an image alignment method for electron tomography is presented which is based on local cross-correlation and adaptive searching. Using several feature regions to compute cross-correlation instead of whole image can overcome the noise-sensitivity of the cross-correlation method. And the adaptive searching can improve the accuracy of alignment in effective time.

articleTitle: A hybrid ant colony algorithm for the capacitated vehicle routing problem
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The capacitated vehicle routing problem (CVRP) is one of the most important problems in the optimization of distribution networks. The objective of CVRP, known demands on the cost of originating and terminating at a delivery depot, is to determine the optimal set of routes for a set of vehicles to deliver customers. CVRP is known to be NP-hard problem, and then it is difficult to solve this problem directly when the problem size is large. In this paper, a hybrid algorithm of simulated annealing and ant colony is applied to solve CVRP. It takes the advantages of simulated annealing and ant colony optimization for solving the capacitated vehicle routing problem. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm is able to find solutions for CVRP.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of informatized assessment system on electrical fault maintenance-- taken electrical fault detection of refrigeration equipment as an example
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper narrates the design on constructing informatized training and assessment system of refrigerate equipment. Through the analysis of functional module such as RS485, intelligent embedded controllers, simulation training platform, the characteristics of higher efficiency, low-loss, lowcost, guarantee the fairness and just of the examination are mainly discussed.

articleTitle: Robust adaptive convergence of uncertain CGNNs with mixed delays
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, the problem of robust adaptive convergence for uncertain Cohen-Grossberg neural networks(CGNNs) with mixed delays is investigated. Using the Lyapunov method and employing a novel lemma, some delay-independent conditions are derived to ensure the state variables of the discussed robust system to converge, globally, uniformly, exponentially to a ball in the state space with a pre-specified convergence rate. The effectiveness and usefulness of the results has been verified by a numerical example with graphical illustrations.

articleTitle: Research of elastic anisotropy based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper uses the superority of the neural networks to get mechanical properties of the elastic anisotropy from nanoidentation load-displacement data. The creation of the training simples, the composing of the neural network and the method of the input vectors are discussed in details. Well experimental results are obtained, This technique has become a new vehicle to get mechanical properties.

articleTitle: A scheme for morphological skeleton pruning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper reports a pruning scheme specifically for morphological skeletons. We polished the boundary/axis ratio significance measure by H. Blum and R. N. Nagel to a contour length significance measure, CLSM. We analyzed its advantages compared to two recently proposed pruning approaches, and designed an adequate algorithm for it, based on a firm mathematical MAT theory by H. I. Choi et al. After a thorough analysis on skeletons generated by a typical morphological skeletonization function, Matlab bwmorph, we proposed and implemented suitable preprocessing techniques such as single lining and end extending. We then formulated a perfect pruning scheme and showed its power via experiments on a standard data set, the part B of the MPEG-7 CE-Shape-1 data set. Algorithmic analysis showed that the scheme has linear computational complexity with respect to n, the pixel number in the initial skeleton.

articleTitle: Building Quick Service Query List(QSQL) to support automated service discovery and composition
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Service computing is emerging as a promising computing paradigm to offer the convenience for users to resolve complex business process problems on an integrated, large-scale, distributed and heterogeneous Internet environments. To successfully execute a business process, the workflow creation by depending on service discovery techniques should be made in the first place. Particularly, semantics have been proposed as a key to automatically solving service discovery problem for facilitating users create a workflow. However, most of semantic service discovery and composition methods still remain at a low efficiency stage because they generally involve time consuming ontology reasoning and manual processing. To address this problem, we present an efficient service discovery and composition method by building quick service query list (QSQL) to support automated processes for creating a workflow. QSQL is an efficient service index list which can be dynamically built by service publication algorithm. In QSQL, semantic relationships between the published services and all related ontology concepts can be processed in advance and simultaneously recorded in QSQL data model so that the large number of ontology reasoning can be avoided at service discovery stage. Further, our proposed algorithms can efficiently select and combine service models from QSQL to match a user query.

articleTitle: A modified strong proxy signature with proxy signer privacy protection
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In 1996, Mambo et al. first introduced the concept of a proxy signature scheme. In 2001, Lee et al. constructed a strong non-designated proxy signature scheme. In 2002, Shum and Wei presented an enhancement to the Lee et al.’s scheme to hide the identity of the proxy signer. No one can determine the identity of the proxy signer only from the proxy signature. Moreover, a trusted authority can reveal the proxy signer’s identity if needed. However, In 2005, Narn-Yih Lee *, Ming-Feng Lee showed that the Shum-Wei scheme cannot keep the property of the strong unforgeability. That is, not only the proxy signer but also the original signer can generate valid proxy signatures. On the base of it, So we present a modified strong proxy signature scheme with proxy signer privacy protection which is efficient and secure.

articleTitle: An improved tabu search for the Split Delivery VRP
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper describes the split deliveries vehicle routing problem briefly and presents an improved tabu search algorithm. At each iteration, a neighbor solution at each iteration by removing a customer from a set of routes where it is currently visited and inserting it either into a new route or into an existing route that has enough residual capacity. The algorithm also considers the possibility of inserting a customer into a route without removing it from another route. The insertion of a customer into a route is done by means of the cheapest insertion method. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm is feasible and valid for the Split Delivery VRP.

articleTitle: Research of classification hypersurface based on tangent circular arc smooth SVM (TAC-SSVM)
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The lack of efficient heuristic information is the fundamental reason that causes the low effectiveness of currently used approaches for extracting symbolic rules. Classification hypersurface are direct heuristic information for selecting attributes. In SVM (Support Vector Machine), classification hypersurface is emphasized because of the direct induction of the support vectors. In this paper, a new SVM model and a new measurement method of the classification power of attributes on the basis of the characteristics of the classification hypersurfaces based on the proposed SVM model is presented. The experimental results prove that the approach proposed can improve the validity of the extracted rules remarkably compared with other rule extracting approach.

articleTitle: Literary infiltration in computer education
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Computer education usually includes the theory description, deduction of equations, the proof experiment, comprehensive conclusion, etc. In its teaching materials, there is seldom the literary flavor language, indication or sample question related to the essence of computer education. Based on the theory and the practice, we propose the literary infiltration in computer education in the hope of enhancing balance of literal arts and engineering instruction. The presented article discusses the reason and how to introduce appropriately the unique Chinese national culture accomplishment ancient poetries, couplets, well-turned sentences, and famous phrases in the teaching material, so as to bring the interest and innovates to the computer education, meanwhile, reducing the dullness of the teaching material in order to make the computer engineering students receive the national culture in the study of the technical knowledge.

articleTitle: Mobile learning system based on Learning Unit
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to support large-scale mobile learning software running on the resource- limited mobile devices, a mobile learning system based on Learning Unit (LU) is introduced. First the LU model is described, then the integrated architecture of the system is presented and some critical problems in it such as the structure of the client system and the LU manager are discussed. The experiment indicates that the model is reasonable and the implement is reliable. It effectively supports the application of mobile learning software migrating in the wireless environment.

articleTitle: The research on Knowledge Management in Digital Library
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper elicits the conclusion that Knowledge Management in Digital Library should include Knowledge-oriented management, Human-oriented management, and Ability-oriented management as the emphasis formation parts, on the basis of the study on essential theory of Knowledge Management in Digital Library. Then, designing the pattern of Knowledge Management in Digital Library from the three levels - knowledge resources management, human resources management, and organizational construction.

articleTitle: Spatial correction of echo planar imaging deformation for subject specific diffusion tensor MRI analysis
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Diffusion tensor magnetic resonance imaging (DT-MRI or DTI) is a specialized mode of MRI, used for functional imaging of the body's internal structures. Echo planar imaging (EPI), the currently accepted protocol for acquiring DTI, suffers from severe image artefact, which complicates analysis of the data. We present our current progress in registration of T2-weighted MRI acquired with EPI and conventional protocols. The reported algorithm uses a multiresolution registration method with B-spline transform to correct for spatial deformation. This is the first step in registration of a full DTI dataset. It was found that direct application of a popular B- spline algorithm can correct some deformation in the images but further refinements are required to achieve more accurate results.

articleTitle: The TCM study on voice frequency of women with cold and hot constitutions
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The phonation frequencies of Jiao, Zhi and Yu of women with mild constitution are higher than the detection frequency of other phonations, In accordance with the theory of five Viscera harmonizing pitch, women is dominated by blood, the liver and kidney are 724 woman's congenital dependence and woman is apt to be influenced by feeling, etc. man are more prone to phonation of Yu and woman to phonation of Jiao, and the frequency of phonation is proportional to temperature, therefore, man has a hotter constitution than woman because the frequency of Yu phonation is higher than that of Jiao phonation.

articleTitle: The time-scaling and Pitch-Shifting algorithms for blackfin DSP
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Audio effects processing technology is widely used in various types of music production, live performances and other occasions. Most of traditional technologies produce real-time audio effects with hardware analog circuits. In this paper, focus on the demand of time scaling, pitch shifting and special effects of real-time audio. Improve the algorithm performance, efficiency and effectiveness in subjective base on traditional phase vocoder model in high performance DSP processor BlackFin which be made the use of its structural features. Experiment shows that, new algorithm do well in both computation and hearing effect.

articleTitle: Evaluation of GBE50 against myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury with myocardial mechanics and hemodynamic information
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Objective: To observe the protective effects of Ginkgo biloba extract(GBE50) on the myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury(IRI) of rats, and to investigate the evaluating functions of myocardial mechanics and hemodynamic information. Methods: 65 SD rats were randomly allocated into 6 groups: model group, GBE50 low/middle/ high dosage group, Danshen group, and Diltiazem group. The perfusion was stopped for 30 min after the heart was perfused in vitro for 15 min, and then it was reperfused for 40 min. The pressure in the left ventricle was recorded to observe the effects of drugs on myocardial mechanics and hemodynamics. Results: middle dosage of GBE50, Danshen, and Diltiazen could improve the heart functions after IRI, DP and plusmndp/dtmax were higher than those in the model group, and t-dp/dtmax and LVDP were lower than those in the model group. Conclusion: GBE50 could prevent the decrease of heart function after IRI to protect the heart function. And evaluation with myocardial mechanics and hemodynamic information is stable and credible.

articleTitle: 3D models’ indexing and compression storage in digital library
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: 3D digital library is a hotspot in recent years. With the continuing development of 3D graphics technology, 3D model as the fourth-generation media has been one of the digital resources in digital library. This article analyzes the progress of two directions: 3D model indexing and compression. At last, we propose a simple frame of 3D model indexing and compression in digital library.

articleTitle: The briefest reduct of rough sets based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper focuses on the discussion about the briefest reduct of Rough Sets which is extracted by genetic algorithm. The fitting function is designed by the combination of the relying degree of RS and sum of seeds which is the attributes of data.
