Genetic Algorithm operator is applied and the algorithm is tested by UCI database. After the analysis and discussion, RGA and RGA_2 have been proved available. In the discussion, crossover and mutation probability have got a experienced number. Increasing the sum of seeds, and saving the last generation optimized seeds can be improving the efficiency of algorithm.

articleTitle: One design method of license plate recognition system with high recognition rate
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In present, due to the problem of low recognition rate in License Plate Recognition System(LPRS), this paper brings about one design method of LPR system with high recognition rate and quick recognition speed. The main design idea and the innovation of this system is to makes use of three kinds of algorithms to recognize the license for the high recognition rate and provides the hard platform with three Digital Signal Processor (DSP) and dual Field Programmable Gates Array (FPGA) for the quick recognition speed. Furthermore, because of the method about the Electronic Toll Collection (ETC) system, this system will have a promising future.

articleTitle: Numerical simulations of edge detection effect due to chemical shift variation in intermolecular multiple-quantum coherence MRI
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Combined with the theories of intermolecular multiple-quantum coherences (iMQCs) and distant dipolar field (DDF) effect, edge detection effect due to chemical shift variation in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) was simulated and discussed deeply using an efficient numerical algorithm based on the nonlinear Bloch equations. Simulation results show that, different from the conventional MRI signal, chemical shift in iMQC MRI can provide new imaging information, an edge detection method to search regions containing spins with chemical shift offset. The edge detection method can present plentiful information about various kinds of edges of object regions.

articleTitle: Clustering problem based on ant colony algorithm and it’s application in dietary nutrition decision supporting system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The work presented in this thesis is part of the research carried out in the dietary nutrition decision supporting problem (DNDSP) [1]. This thesis consist of two parts. The first part presents ant colony algorithm’s basic principle and its typicle application in traveling salesman problem(TSP). Firstly, put forward the clustering analysis, which based on the ant colony algorithm, the incretion in each path would be renewed in each searching time, then the path which had the most incretion would be selected as the result. The second part of the thesis mainly involves with its application in DNDSP and sums up the research result with forms., combining technology of Asp.Net, network technology and Chinese Dietary Reference Intakes (DRIs), the based Browser/Server dietary decision support system is developed as the previous requirement, and the details implement is showed subsequently; Computer simulations demonstrate that the artificial ant colony is capable of generating good solutions to DNDSP, meanwhile show algorithm’s validity.

articleTitle: Analyzing the economic efficiency of resource allocation based on avoiding network congestion
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The demand for network resource is adjust through the unit price of resource. When the demand of users is larger than Service Provider (SP)psilas supply, the price rises, users have to reduce their demand to maximize their utility, and then the network congestion will be relieved. The process of adjusting takes some time, the network will be in congestion state in that period of time. In order to avoid network congestion, SP can choose such strategy: when the demand is close, not equal, to the supply from the left, the price starts rising to prevent the increase of the demand, users reduce their demand before the occur of congestion. This method avoids congestion, but also results in the economic deficiency of resource allocation the earlier the price starts going up, the more the total utility of SP and uses falls. It is better that SP still rise the price after the congestion occurs, it is better the network is in low-grade congestion. Simulations are performed to verify the conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on electrocardiograph center system based on ASP medical pattern
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The thesis has studied the electrocardiograph center system which is based on ASP medical pattern. Firstly, the medical treatment ASP pattern is established, and ECG Center based on medical ASP pattern is analysized. How the system is realized is introduced. The result has indicated that it can resolve the problems of medical software cost and being short of medical expert.

articleTitle: Design of user-oriented Meta Service-based repository for e-health service
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The target of constructing a user-oriented service repository of e-health is to offer an infrastructure to facilitate the interaction of service providers with its potential consumers directly. A Meta Service-based service description framework and the repository architecture were proposed to meet the requirements from the two types of users. The open and accurate description properties can be utilized by consumers to easily represent their personal rules to discover and select their preference services. A GUI generated through Meta Service can navigate a consumer to send his request to the selected service while not necessary to know the technical details. The implementation of a repository prototype verified the feasibility of our approach.

articleTitle: A pulse signal processing system for analysis of tumor sickness and syndrome
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Pulse signal checking is one of the four Chinese traditional medical diagnosis methods. But few of doctors can use these techniques now in practical diagnosis because of difficulty of understanding. In this paper, a modern pulse signal processing system based on TMS320C6713 DSP for tumor sickness diagnosis and syndromes analysis is described. Pulse signal is sampled with 300 Hz frequency and 8 bits quantization, then saved in a data buffer with length of 10 Kbytes to be processed by DSP. Linear predictive cepstrum coefficient is selected as features and vector quantization is hired for model training. The system is designed to be used as a tumor sickness diagnosis and syndrome analysis assistant in practical application.

articleTitle: Application of Agent-aided CVE in remote collaborative experiment
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Since experiment is one collaborative activity and usually needs people collaborate together, itpsilas very important to study how to realize the collaboration among users in remote experiment. In this paper, the architecture of an Agent-aided cooperative model and its cooperation mechanism are proposed. Based on the architecture, one Agent-aided collaborative virtual experiment system is built. It proves that by applying CVE and Agent technologies we can provide an effective way to manage the remote collaborative experiment.

articleTitle: The application of niche technology in cooperative learning
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, based on the discussion of some important issues related to cooperative e-learning, and the analysis for niche technology, a group classifier algorithm and a sharing learning algorithm are put forward. The aim is to support cooperative learning in e-learning environment.

articleTitle: Ideas for teacher-learner emotional interaction in Networked teaching
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Teacher-Learner Interaction is the primary link for efficiency and quality in Networked teaching. Due to the features of networked teaching different from those of conventional teaching, the absence of emotion is common in teacher-learner interaction of Networked teaching. However, emotional design of the Human-Computer Interaction provides some ideas of solution for this puzzle. In this paper, we give a theoretic analysis of evidences and reasons for emotion absence in teacher-learner interaction. And this paper presents some ideas for improvement of networked interaction between media and users, enhance emotional factors in the process, and provide series of useful and efficient strategies for teacher-learner interaction.

articleTitle: A novel trust model based on D-S evidence reasoning and Fuzzy Cognitive time Map
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper presented an approach for trust computing using Fuzzy Cognitive Map and D-S evidence reasoning theory. As fuzzy inference can deal with variable dependencies in the system by decoupling dependable variables, FCM provides an efficient way to trust deducing, and also the difficulty and complexity of trust computing. The approach of DS evidence overcomes the problem of over-precision.

articleTitle: An efficient hierarchical rights authorization scheme for offline content protection
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Digital rights management (DRM) technology aims to distribute digital contents to users in a controlled manner that can protect the copyright of contents. Most previous DRM schemes do not consider user relations and content relations, thus it results in inefficiency and produces much overhead. In this paper, an efficient hierarchical rights authorization scheme for offline content protection (HRAS) is proposed in distance education system of university/college. Based on certain hierarchical rights relations of users and course contents in distance education system, a logical key graph is constructed in HRAS and two algorithms are designed respectively to construct the key graph. A comparison with other DRM schemes has shown that HRAS is efficient and has low overhead.

articleTitle: A novel parallel iterative cycle QR decomposition detection algorithm in VBLAST-OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A novel parallel iterative cycle QR decomposition detection algorithm in VBLAST-OFDM system is proposed in this paper. In order to overcome the disadvantage of the poor performance of the first detected layer in IQRD algorithm, the parallel detection is applied to the IQRD algorithm and the performance is improved effectively. Simulation results show that the proposed P-IQRD algorithm is superior to the IQRD algorithm.

articleTitle: Research of TCM syndrome simulation teaching platform
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: TCM syndrome simulation teaching platform is a new type of teaching & scientific research simulation platform with human-machine dialogue function established on the basis of borrowing the domestic and foreign relevant research work. It is composed of disease display unit, human-machine dialogue interrogation unit, TCM syndrome diagnosis & treatment unit and feedback unit. Thi platform is mainly controlled by the computer. It can really display the patient’s information such as tongue image, simulated pulse image and point tenderness. Besides, it will be connected with the interrogation unit, TCM syndrome diagnosis & treatment unit and feedback unit so as to realize the realtime simulation to the real patients, attain the objective of realtime simulated diagnosis and treatment and demonstrate TCM diagnosis features. It is featured as convenient operation, risklessness, repeated use, recordability of teaching and training results. It has demonstrated the advantages of simulated teaching.

articleTitle: The multimedia educational resources editing system on synchronization of PPT presentation videos and electronic slides
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As the primary format, the research of presentation videos with electronic documents has vital significance. Based on the research of synchronization technology and SCORM specification, this paper proposed an semiautomatic algorithm on sync of the PPT presentation videos and their electronic slides, designed an editing system for educational resources (referred to PPT presentation videos and electronic slides in this paper), and implemented the resourcespsila organization and view, temporal linking of the video and its source document, shot annotating and retrieval. Otherwise, a brief process of creating high-quality SCORM-compliant content package is presented.

articleTitle: A fragile watermarking scheme based on integer wavelet transform
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A fragile watermarking scheme based on integer wavelet transform and chaos sequence is proposed in this paper. The novel watermarking scheme uses the quad tree structures received by the wavelet decomposition and chaos sequences to choose locations where are embedded the watermark information. The scheme has high signal-to-noise because it only embed watermark into the latest bit of node. It is suitable for medical image and it is also easy to implement on hardware. The difference between the scheme and other schemes based on integer wavelet transform is that we embed watermark on the coefficients of integer wavelet transform separately.

articleTitle: A novel design of a portable otoacoustic emissions detecting system based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Most traditional designs of otoacoustic emissions (OAEs) detecting system adopt the model of “Sensor + Sound Signal Sampler / Generator + Personal Computer”. This kind of model has shortcomings that it is apt to introduce exterior noises and lacks system integration, which often brings much inconvenience into the process of measuring. Different from the forementioned kind of control unit, digital signal processor (DSP) is a kind of elegant new design, with a complete set of common system peripherals, to provide hand-held devices with low-cost and high-performance microcontroller solution in small size. In this article, a novel design of a highly integrated and printed portable otoacoustic emissions detecting system based on DSP (mainly for TEOAE) is presented. The ratio of detecting is 100%.

articleTitle: The application of DSS for faculty management on OA system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper sets up a DSS for faculty management on OA system, which is based on the status of faculty management and the faculty information of universities. The model of faculty total forecast is set up by gray system, and the model of classified forecast is set up by Markov model, and the design method is explained in this paper. This system has a good forecast precision by experience.

articleTitle: The application of computer aided teaching in NC programming
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to improve the teaching effect of NC programming computer aided teaching method has been used which based on the key technology of virtual NC machining simulation. The process of how to use computer aided teaching technology in NC programming has been thoroughly discussed and a web-based NC programming teaching system has been given. The teaching content is based on the characteristic of different students which can arouse their learning interesting and can dig the potential of different students. The relationship of virtual NC simulation and practice machining operation has been addressed in order to achieve a satisfied effect.

articleTitle: Designing interactive education system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Interactivity acts a role of activator which can transform the traditional classroom into an active media environment that not only facilitates the students to receive information but also helps the educators to teach in an effective way. However the standards or the contents for interactivity within education are by no means clear, that impairs the efficiency of interactivity. In this paper, we propose the interface for interactive education (IIE) to provide an efficient solution for interactive education. The IIE consists of modularization hardware infrastructures and middleware based system software. Our main focus is to design interactive systems for the educators who only need to choose the components making up a specific system to execute different functions. The following article summarizes some of our key concepts for interface and interaction design.

articleTitle: Automatic detection of QRS onset in ECG signals
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, a new modified method based on the multi-scale morphological derivative (MMD) transform technique is described for the detection of QRS onset in ECG signals. According to our experiments, we find the criterions of wave classification, the appropriate value of threshold and transform scales. When these are all settled down, this algorithm can set different scales to perform the MMD transform according to different lengths of QRS waves. By testing our method with ECG data from CSE database, we prove that our method can process lots of signals with various waveforms efficiently.

articleTitle: Knowledge management system for screed design of Asphalt Paver
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: With the development of economy globalization, Knowledge Management System (KMS) has emerged as a major issue that designers or companies must deal with. KMS opens up another domain for building new engineering design methodology, which is highly creative, knowledge-intensive, extensive information exchange and communication among distributed teams. KMS overcomes the obstacles of failling to provide adequate support and integrating product information due to their inflexible data structures in traditional design method. Asphalt Paver works as a construction machine mainly used for the paving project on the road base and surface for highway of various kinds of material. Screed is the kernel function part of paver, so researching the new design approach of screed is the key for developing new pavers. In this paper, we advocate a knowledge management system for screed design of Asphalt Paver, develop the framework and express the implement process of KMS.

articleTitle: An optimal approach to aligning on-line handwritten signatures
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: On-line handwritten signature aligning is crucial in verification. This paper deals with this aligning as an optimization problem. By transforming the squared Euclidean distance based DTW distance in terms of geometric transformations including rotation, scaling and translation, corresponding optimal objective functions are formulated and solved in closed form. Subsequently, an iterative optimization procedure, named DTWOA, is proposed as a systematic aligning approach. Experimental results conducted on SVC2004 dataset show that DTWOA converges rapidly, and the standard deviation of the optimal DTW distances is much smaller and smoother than the original, which manifests the availability of our work.

articleTitle: A stratum approach to process temporal information in education field
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Temporal information processing in education field is an important and challenging issue in database application systems. After the shortages of current temporal data management are analyzed in detail, this paper introduces TDBEngine:a middleware approach to implement temporal information processing. We introduce the characters of TDBEnginepsilas query Language-ATSQL2 and characters of TDBEnginepsilas architecture and then give the application model for using TDBEngine; Finally, We illustrate the application method in temporal educational information process using TDBEngine.

articleTitle: 3D nerve: A three-dimensional reconstruction system for peripheral nerves
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Repair and regeneration of injured peripheral nerves have always been a focus in the field of orthopedics. Traditional nerve atlas contains only two-dimensional information and canpsilat display the real cross and recombination process of nerve bundles in its whole length. To solve this problem, a system, 3D nerve, is proposed for the 3D reconstruction of peripheral nerves. Through image registration, image segmentation, contour correspondence and surface reconstruction process, this system successfully represents the topographic anatomy of every nerve fascicle and its relationship with the nicety localization information of sense fibers and motor ones in arbitrary sections. It is a great help for clinical peripheral nerve repair and 3D peripheral nerve teaching.

articleTitle: WFVL: Workflow Technology Based Virtual Laboratory System
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The engineering experiments need to highlight the logics, steps, rules and details of involved intricate operations, but which are always neglected by the students. In this paper, we propose our Workflow Technology Based Virtual Laboratory System (WFVL) for data mining. It subdivides the general data analysis model into detachable elements and encapsulates them as reusable web services, which can be selected and linked referring to different operation logic or existing workflow model to create, achieve and observe different virtual experiments based on simulation data. WFVL uses the Predictive Model Markup Language (PMML) to describe different user models, which can be stored into model repository for teachers to create analysis or evaluation report of experimental teaching.

articleTitle: Research and application of Customizable Cooperative Work Framework architecture based on SOA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: As new software development architecture, the Customizable Cooperative Work Framework can be used for software development with the method of customization. The Business Workflow Instance and its Business Action Instance’s execution order can be customized dynamic by assembling the Business Object Components to the Service Customization Component, and make the Service Customization Component as the node in the Business Workflow. The Business Object Component’s attribute and presentation form, Service Customization Component and the Business Workflow Instance can be customized to implement customizing special domain’s whole Service Process. At last, we use the Customizable Cooperative Work Framework to implement an antetype system named SCCWFADP, and introduce a customization application instance in the educational domain.

articleTitle: Promoting learner autonomy in Internet and multimedia-assisted college English teaching-learning in China
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper attempts to advocate learner autonomy in current Internet and multimedia-assisted college English teaching-learning in China. To achieve this aim, it first offers the fundamental issues of learner autonomy; then it struggles to prove that learner autonomy may serve as a feasible solution to the different kinds of pressure in college English teaching-learning. Furthermore, the advanced technology and instruments of Internet and multimedia used in college English classes have not only increased the chances for learners and teachers, but also at the same time posed more challenges to them. How to foster learner autonomy under this circumstance reveals more significance. Last, this paper endeavors to conceive the construction of campus learning network to promote learner autonomy.

articleTitle: The navigation teaching training in higher education based on computer technology and simulation technique
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This article aims at the application question of computer technology and simulation technique in the navigation teaching training of higher education, mainly discusses the navigation simulator teaching trainingpsilas request of the International Maritime Organization in the STCW 78/95 convention, analyzes the composition and basic construction of the bridge operation simulator, as well as the teaching function of bridge operation simulator and the utilization.

articleTitle: Design of multi-function solar-wireless network server for education
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Multi-function solar-wireless network server is adding solar and WLAN together. The most important development technology for multi-function solar-wireless network server is using solar energy to be the power supply and customized multi-function wireless net services. With all of this the purpose is giving us an easy using, cheap, clean and convenient wireless net server. In the paper, we will show implementation of solar energy control and real useful net services from two parts: high efficiency circuit design and stable software design.

articleTitle: Information technology in rescue knowledge learning system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Usually, people do not have sufficient knowledge for emergency rescue. Furthermore, they panic when facing emergency situations. It might delay the first aid help. On the other hand, the insufficient knowledge of first aid could cause the unnecessary regret. In order to cope with the above problems, this study constructs a mobile emergency rescue training system which helps users obtain relevant disease information and find suitable medical expert according to the input symptoms terms. With the implementation of this system, authors wish to improve learners’ emergency rescue knowledge and to provide an emergency rescue training platform for first aid personnel. Except for the medical personnel, people rarely have the opportunity to access to the rescue knowledge. The design of this study is relatively simple and allows learners to accomplish diseases or injuries searching by inputting the observed symptoms. Term frequency and inverse document frequency are applied for the information retrieval. After searching, we can learn and follow the first-aid instructions or ask for the experts’ opinions through the system.

articleTitle: Retrieving the agenda information of telephone based on symbian OS
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The agenda database file, stored in the telephony, is rich of personal information. Analyzing and extracting the useable clues is very significant for case-investigation and evidence-gaining. First of all, it is necessary to analyze the data structure of the database files and retrieve the information. In this paper, I find out the data structure of agenda files, on the IDE-- Carbide C++ developed by Nokia in use of database API (Application Program Interface), which is provided by SDK (Software Development Kit) of Carbide C++. And I test the program on the N90.At last, I get a good result.

articleTitle: A virtual classroom platform based on text to visual speeches
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The paper proposes a virtual classroom platform based on text to visual speeches (TTVS). The platform uses a client-server structure. Unlike current speech-driven virtual classroom techniques, the platform provides textual communications among users to obtain high transmission speed and communication quality. Every user has his/her own avatar in the classroom. In each user end, received textual messages are synthesized into speeches and spoken by the avatar of one who sends the messages. Avatars can also express some typical human emotions and intentions through body languages and simple facial expressions, so that receivers understand messages impressively. Algorithms for controlling avatarpsilas movement based on body functions are proposed.

articleTitle: Design for the embedded network protocol simulation experiment system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The basic concepts and technologies of the computer network involve numerous abstract theories and a mass of network protocols, which make many abecedarians difficult to understand. Trying to solve this problem, a network protocol simulation experiment system was constructed based on the PXA255 Xscale processor and the Linux embedded system to help with the simulation teaching of TCP/IP protocols. Under an undisturbed environment with no interference from other packets, and real actions of computer network being well simulated, this system enables students to better understand interactive steps of network protocols and communication mechanisms between correlative protocols.

articleTitle: Rank queries in probabilistic data integration systems for digital library federation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In digital library federation, a challenge is how to exchange and share information on heterogeneous digital libraries. The mediator-based approach of data integration provide a uniform view by creating the semantic relationship between sources and mediated schema. Since automatic matching produce probabilities, it’s necessary to take the probability of mappings into consideration. Further more, for tuples’ probabilities arise as an additional ranking dimension, both tuple probabilities and scores be factored in the interpretation of top-k queries in probabilistic databases.In this paper, after proposing a architecture of data integration for DLF, we demonstrate the probabilities for the schema mappings and query answerings. Then, having discussed the opt_U-kRank algorithm, we describe the revised_U-kRank algorithm which may improve the efficiency of execution. Finally, based on the experiment results of two U-kRank algorithms, we discuss the effect of probabilities distribution on executions.

articleTitle: The use of computer modeling techniques in near infrared spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Science developments entered a new era in the 21 century. The tendency is clear. The individual scientific fields started to cross each other again in order to have the depth and width in the development. Especially the computer science, it is the fundamental pillar for all the others sciences nowadays. A good example is its applications in Near Infrared spectroscopy (NIR). NIR is a rather new molecular vibrational spectroscopy in the analytical science field. Because of its advantages of being suitable to measure both liquid and solid samples, non destructive to samples, quite acceptable instrumental S/N ratio and sensitivity, NIR technique can be used in many in-line or off-line quantitative analysis. Although NIR only started its development from the 80s of last century, this new technology is developing so quickly that NIR applications have already covered the field of agriculture, material manufacture and chemical industries, petroleum and chemical refining, pharmaceutics and cosmetics etc. It has been widely accepted by many industries, academics and R & D institutes all over the world. However, NIR spectroscopy is a secondary analytical technique. The development of NIR applications is completely dependent upon the good use of Chemometrics, which is a computerized mathematical modeling technique utilized in the analytical field. In the other words, the critical step of a successful NIR application is to make a good NIR calibration model. With a commercially available NIR instrument, to scan the samples and to obtain the NIR spectra are very simple. Furthermore, to use the instrument software to make a pseudo calibration model is also quite easy, but whether the model made will predict the concentration of the relevant components correctly in the unknown samples, is not guaranteed. In this paper, with some real analytical data sets, how to use the major fussy mathematical concepts, such as Principal Components Analysis (PCA), Partial List Square (PLS) etc., in modeling for various applications of NIR spectroscopy will be thoroughly reviewed and discussed.

articleTitle: Improvement of one-dimensional gradient shimming method in nuclear magnetic resonance experiments
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) plays an important role in the fields of physics, chemistry, biology and medicine. The homogeneity of the magnetic field is very significant for NMR experiment. Based on the principle of field mapping, gradient shimming is an efficient method to achieve a homogeneous magnetic field. Reflecting accurately the spatial magnetic field distribution produced by every shim coil, gradient shimming can optimize the homogeneity efficiently and quickly. In this paper, one-dimensional gradient shimming method was studied, and the corresponding computational process was improved. Experiments were done on the NMR spectrometer, and the results show that the improved algorithm operates more efficiently and still works in a great inhomogeneous magnetic field.

articleTitle: An improved clustering algorithm based on MANET network
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: MANET as a new type of mobile wireless networks, its unique characteristics increase the difficulty of the management, in particular, the movement of nodes require more effective management of topology, which nearly pose a challenge. Thus, with the analysis of characteristic and application requirements of the Ad hoc network, a new type of clustering algorithm is proposed based on energy which mainly depends on the number of nodes to cluster the network. The simulation shows that the delay of routing algorithm is low, control spending is less and so on.

articleTitle: Design and construction of training management system with rich internet application for running in physical education
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The purpose of this research is to design and construct a prototype training management system (TMS) enabling university students in physical education to easily establish the Plan-Do-See Cycle (PDSC) for running. In system design, firstly, we considered required functions of the TMS. Secondly, we adopted a platform-independent Web-based system to the TMS. Thirdly, we considered security, privacy, and usability for the TMS. From the above design specifications, we constructed a prototype TMS composed of a Web server, a Web application, and a database server. A rich Internet application (RIA) was built for the user interface in order to enhance usability. To promote the students' PDSC, the RIA had three functions: a training diary function, a feedback function, and a message board function. We conclude that the prototype TMS has enough ability to enable the students to easily establish the PDSC for running.

articleTitle: Caching learning units on mobile terminal unit in a mobile learning system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to support large-scale mobile learning software running on the resource-limited mobile devices, a cache management on mobile terminal units in a mobile learning system based on Learning Unit (LU) is introduced. The generation-based algorithm in memory management according to the adaptive thinking is introduced. Considering the different characteristics of the objects in the less-relied generation and the more relied generation, different allocating methods and garbage collecting algorithm are adopted. These methods highly improve the efficiency of the cache management and avoid longtime problem in general garbage collecting algorithms. The experiment indicates that the cache management is reasonable and effectively supports the application of the mobile learning software for mobile terminal units.

articleTitle: Hybrid prediction model based on BP neural network for lung cancer
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Recent researches show that lung cancer owns actual dose-response relationship with calendar-year smoking environment exposure matrix and individual medical record. In this paper, two hybrid prediction models based on BP neural network, ES (exponential smoothing) and FCM (Fuzzy C-Means) clustering are proposed to predict the possible rate and ages of smokers suffering the lung cancer. The BP-ES (Exponential Smoothing) model can exert the superiorities of the time series datum of smoking crowds and other pathogenic factors; and the BPFCM clustering model can reduce the parameter amount and complexity of BP net’s training greatly. The experiments show that the accuracy of the hybrid models are enhanced greatly contrasted with single BP neural network, and can work as effective methods for the statistic, analysis and prediction to lung cancer.

articleTitle: Is free-software open-source ready for medical applications?
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: While in the past years free-software has gained some acceptance in the domain of medical applications it has been mainly focused on quite typical IT-infrastructure cases - may that be billing systems, data warehousing, databases and content management systems a second area where free software has made prominent entrance has been in the area of imaging and high-volume data processing. In the area of medical devices, with rare exceptions, free-software is still quite underrepresented - in part due to acceptance but in part also due to plain technical reasons. GNU/Linux, real-time and embedded variants and many free-software projected have made there way into medical applications - but is Free-software ready to cover the wide area of demands on medical platforms and there applications? The demands of medical platforms stretch more or less the entire range of computational capabilities: * battery powered - robust against power-failures * reliable in rough environment * compliant with safety regulations * robust and secure software platforms * standalone, networked all the way to clusters * extensibility for specialized hardware and software * from head-less to multithread graphical user-interfaces

articleTitle: An improved genetic algorithm for grain distribution centers locations
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Grain distribution center is the pivot of a grain logistics system. To define the location of grain logistics distribution center is the key of grain logistics system analysis. In this paper, according to the characteristics and requirements in the selection of the location, a mathematical model applied to the location selection was established on the basis of lowest transportation cost. Genetic Algorithm was then used to solve the model, and the optimal solution of the model was obtained by selecting the encode method and genetic operator correctly, thus verifying the correctness of the model. The instance demonstrates that the algorithm can effectively get the grain logistics center optimal solution.

articleTitle: Design of a micro-fluidic chip electrophoresis control system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: A control system for micro-fluidic chip was designed and realized in this paper. The serial controlled A/D and D/A chips were chosen to reduce the amount of control ports. FPGA with plenty of control ports was chosen to be system MCU, on which programming in VerilogHDL, and as a result 30 chips can be controlled synchronously. Communication between PC and USB2.0 high-speed transfer interface chip were applied to meet the needs of control and uploading data. We compiled Windows XP based driver and control software, in addition. Conclusively, the system can control multiple chips at the same time to improve the detecting efficiency and can be used when detecting for large quantity of chips was needed.

articleTitle: Optimizing the route selection of transit based on genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The solution to the route selection problem of transit was converted to minimum spanning tree (MST) problem. Compared with the classic MST algorithm, an improved genetic algorithm is introduced to search the minimum spanning trees based on the graphic theory. This algorithm uses binary code to represent the problem of minimum spanning trees and uses the depth first search method to determine the connectivity of the graph. The corresponding fitness function, single parent transposition operator, single parent reverse operators and controlling evolutionary strategies are designed to improve its speed and efficiency. In comparison with traditional algorithms, it can acquire a set of minimum spanning trees during one genetic evolutionary process, make decision-department consider synthetically the various factors to do comprehensive evaluation and decision-making.

articleTitle: Research of CPIT and its supporting system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Information technologies (IT) have exerted a remarkable influence on college education, which is greatly aided by Internet and information system. Although the traditional instructional model is propitious toward a solid basic knowledge for students, it is unpropitious for better learner autonomy and innovation. Currently, there is wide incompatibility between the teaching of college public IT and the development of information society, hence some urgent change is required. Under the guidance of teachers, with an optimized environment and improved learner autonomy, students should not only master the knowledge and skills of IT, but also foster the ability of autonomous learning and better innovation. In order to achieve this aim, this paper endeavors to put forward a corresponding precept and an Internet-based aided learning system for the teaching of college public IT.

articleTitle: Visualizing Small World Networks on sphere surface
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Small world networks are common in many applications. Several researches have worked on visualizing small world network for analyses and discovering purpose. However, the results of these visualization technologies still have defect in interactive tasks and performance. Attracted by visualization on spherical surface with a nice balance between visual effect and navigation, we try to exploit fully spherical drawing in case of small-world network. To achieve better performance, this paper present a new fast FDA-based algorithm for fast drawing a small-world network. Its complexity, O(n+e), for each iteration is smaller than other FDA-based methods with O(n2) or O(nlogn). We also use implicit surface to achieve visual abstraction and metaphor of globe for the drawing. Experiment results have shown that our work has achieved improvement both in visual effect and performance than previous works.

articleTitle: The application of Gabor filter in Chinese writer identification
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Writer identification is a technique that aims to decide the identity of writers according to the handwriting styles. In this paper, the whole handwriting is considered as a texture image. A two-dimensional Gabor filter for extracting texture features of Chinese handwritings is designed and tested, which is a key step in the writer identification project. Test results show the filter can efficiently reflect the feature information of handwritings and itpsilas valid for the whole Chinese writer identification project. The method used in this paper has good robustness and is suitable for practical use.

articleTitle: Optimization of nutrition prescription for meals based on multiobjective struggle GA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, we present the nutrition prescription model for meals. Moreover, we present the MOSGA and we analyze it regarding the solution of MOPs. Finally, we apply the MOSGA to solve the nutrition prescription problem with the aim of find the optimum tradeoff surface. In the experiment, we obtain optimized solutions using the MOSGA. The solutions, provided by the proposed algorithm for the nutrition prescription model. are promising when compared with an existing well-known algorithm.

articleTitle: Medical CT Image Preprocessing Based on Edge Detection and Spline Fitting
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: According to the characteristic that the medical CT image data are area samplings, a new preprocessing approach for CT image is presented in this paper. It firstly constructs mapping relationship between area sampling and point sampling, then detect the image edge with Sobel operator, and divide the CT image into different regions based on human tissue feature, and finally, in each divided region, establishes fitting equations with cubic spline, so as to transform area sampling values to more accurate approximations of point sampling values. Using the new transformed values to reconstruct 3-D medical image can improve reconstruction quality. Experiments show that the 3-D reconstructed image based on CT data preprocessed by the new approach can have more detail information.

articleTitle: The information processing platform on systems biology and its application in international market development of Traditional Chinese Medicine
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Firstly this paper analyses the related regulations formulated by the foreign government, such as FDA, USA; contrasting with the characteristics of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), and puts forth the argument that the international market development strategy for TCM should follow the principle of beginning with dietary supplements, through the food for special dietary uses and finally declaring as OTC drugs after the gradual transition from NDA of more mature drugs on the market. The correlated scientific and technological support on systems biology should be that base on the classification of clinic phenotype to setup of the quality-guarantee system and the application standard aiming at symptoms relief for achieving safety and efficacy. The information processing platform on systems biology with its functional units is introduced as a scientific and technical tool to support the international market development of TCM.

articleTitle: A cactus service architecture based on Peer-to-Peer
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The P2P technology makes it possible that the number of the clients can be infinite, while the P2P technology still has some problems. Under the free riding model, someone always shut down the P2P services to others immediately after downloaded he wanted, which will influence the continue service and cause instability and fluctuation. In this paper, a robust architecture, cactus-architecture, is proposed, which can avoid the system fluctuation caused by the new joining nodes or the departing nodes. A new incentive mechanism is introduced, which can well motivate the clients to be providing service.

articleTitle: Study on LEAPS-based method for network data collection
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: This paper introduces the development of the existing SNMP, and the disadvantage of the current SNMP system. After that introduces the SNMP system that is designing and developing, the system can simultaneously support snmpv1. snmpv2c, snmpv3, and can be used in a mixed environment of ipv4/ipv6. This system in light of other similar system uses the LEAPS algorithm to judge the state of network, and thus change the frequency of data collection, at the same time it is based on a modular design, the system can be upgraded easily, and it improves the systempsilas reusability.

articleTitle: Various freed multi-cores RTOS based Linux
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Nowadays multi-cores operating system is widely used in real-time operating systems and embedded operating systems. Multi-cores operating system is stand for a set of system which is based on original system and design for some special purpose. It works as another kernel in the system and only response for several critical areas. These systems are smaller, but most of them will take care of process management which is an important and difficult part in operating system education. So it is more suitable for the operating system teaching. In this paper several open source multi-core operating systems will be introduced especially in process management.

articleTitle: Improved technique to build surface models of the male urogenital organs from visible Korean
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Purpose of this research is to present realistic surface models of male urogenital organs and neighboring structures, made more automatically by using new computer technique. For the purpose, outlining and automatic interpolation was performed on Combustion; surface reconstruction following volume reconstruction was done on 3D-Doctor; the surface models were assembled in their proper positions and refined on Maya; a surface model was coated by real surface texture of the structure acquired from volume model on specially programmed software and Maya. The surface models, prepared in this research, are expected to contribute to medical simulation such as interactive virtual operation. The improved technique to build the surface models, developed in this research, is expected to enable other researchers to easily make their own surface models from other serial images.

articleTitle: 3D entity model reconstruction from section plane views based on ES
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: It is essential to generate efficient three-dimensional (3D) spatial data model in 3D modeling, because the data processed is multiple in scale and large in volume. Based on investigation some existed strategies of 3D solid reconstruction and the features of section plane views, the technology of 3D entity model reconstruction from section plane views based on ES is given in this paper. From the view of engineering application, this paper introduces the reconstruction model of ES and the expression way for the frame knowledge and mainly discusses the discretization of the 3D model face and reasoning algorithm based on discretization meshwork model. Finally combining OpenGL, a simulation system of mineral deposit 3D model is developed. The running result shows that this 3D reconstruction method is much simple and practical, and has a wide area of application.

articleTitle: Knowledge grid application in the digital TCM hospital system
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: The application of Knowledge Grid technology in the process of TCM diagnosis and therapy is introduced in this paper. The idea that combines Knowledge Grid and PACS with digital hospital system to integrate mass heterogeneous medical data is proposed. Then, a meta-model of diagnosis and treatment process of TCM in Grid databases is designed. Anyway, the application of Knowledge Grid can eliminate the information isolation between each hospital, so as to accelerate the construction of digital TCM hospital.

articleTitle: Research and implementation on the system of integrated assessment on-line of urban environmental quality
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In order to evaluate urban environmental quality scientifically, a Multiple Objective Decision-Making Ideal Interval Method (MODMIIM) is presented. This paper introduces the theory of MODMIIM, analyzes the architecture of the system and builds different functional modules. In the end, the system of integrated assessment on-line of urban environmental quality is developed by the technologies of GIS, GPRS, Data Acquisition,. NET and so on.

articleTitle: An internet-based research on digital educational resources sharing
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Services such as searching, transforming and sharing digital educational resources can be effectively realized through metadata. With the rapid development of Internet, digital educational resources have the features of wide distribution, large amount, diverse platform and different standards. Therefore, Internet users are supposed to switch or map the metadata of different standards or patterns, i.e. to realize a kind of metadata interoperation, the main technological methods of which are metadata switching, OAI, metadata reuse and metadata norm control, etc. However, all these methods defects in staying on a specific or abstract grammatical level. A new method, ontology-based metadata interoperation model, can take corresponding measures from semantic and grammatical perspective respectively to successfully solve the problem of interoperation on metadata semantic level.

articleTitle: An active/cooperative role-based open source digital labware for information forensics education
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: Information forensics is one of the fast growing and very demanding courses in the information security area. This emerging discipline has an increasing demand to provide hands-on labs for students to gain real-world experience. The purpose of this paper is twofold.

articleTitle: Research on force feedback technology in virtual surgery simulation
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In this paper, the collision detection and response that based on the OBB (Oriented Bounding Boxes) tree structure was realized in virtual surgery simulation system for nasopharyngeal carcinoma. The point of contact location and the vector of contact surface can be acquired. The force effect in virtual surgery simulation was improved. A twice detection method was proposed to improve the phenomenon of the force puncture, and a synchronize mechanism was adopt to improve the stability of the force output. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm has been enhanced in the force puncture and stability of the force, and the force effect is more authentic.

articleTitle: Smart Process: Service oriented business process management pattern in E-hospital
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: In an E-hospital, there are so many devices and services to cooperate with each other in some specific ldquohospital rulesrdquo which help patients get individual services and treatments, but traditional workflow based technology can hardly complete this task. In this paper Smart Process -- a new business process management pattern is introduced. In this pattern a business process which organizes different devices and services, is automatically generated and adjusted using an MDP based algorithm to provide satisfied individual service for different patients.

articleTitle: Design and realization of license plate recognition system based on DSP and FPGA
publicationTitle: 2008 IEEE International Symposium on IT in Medicine and Education
abstract: License Plate Recognition System (LPRS) is the key technology of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS), which makes great importance in transportation management. In this paper, we designed and realized a real time Embedded LPR System based on Digital Signal Processor (DSP) and Field Programmable Gates Array (FPGA).With the advantage of high speed, high stability, small size, and lower power requirement, this system has the function including the collection, transportation and recognition of license plate image. This paper introduces some modules in LPRS detailedly, including Video input module, DSP module and FPGA module. After simulation and a number of experiments, it is testified that this LPRS gets a better performance and practicability.
